title: Assistant / Deputy Manager – OFR Export Operations
description:
**ABOUT OCEAN FREIGHT OPERATIONS**


The Ocean Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing all ocean\-bound imports and exports, utilizing a diverse range of equipment and services. The team collaborates closely with a network of ocean carriers, Procurement \& capacity management (PCM), and participating in major carrier alliances to secure planned space protection from key container ports globally. This meticulous coordination is essential for ensuring a reliable and efficient transportation process for ocean\-bound cargo.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**

As an integral part of Ocean Freight Export Operations/ Documentation, an incumbent role in ensuring the efficiency of Export processes within the specified region. The role of OFR (Ocean Freight Operations) involves supporting the intricacies of ocean\-bound cargo movements. It involves coordinating with various processes, including vessel scheduling, cargo documentation, interaction with ocean carriers to constantly strive for optimizing efficiency, regulations, and maintaining high standards of service.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Operational Excellence:**


* Ensure cost\-effective and high\-quality export ocean freight operations.
* Assist in procuring and managing cargo capacity efficiently, overseeing all port operations.
* Ensure operational compliance and error\-free documentation.
* Responsible for the smooth execution of export shipments, adhering to customer requirements, country regulations, and customs trade practices.
* Ensure regulatory compliance related to AMS, ACI, ISF, and FMC filing.
* Implement CW1 Best Practices, including auto rating, auto costing, timely and accurate cost estimation, billing, ESI \& E\-Booking, milestone updating, and file closure.
* Achieve set operational performance targets.
* Proactively address and manage operational irregularities.
* Efficiently handle customer complaints and plug potential revenue leakages.
* Avoid claims and penalties due to service failures.
* Adhere to agreed SOP/COP for releasing documents to customers (Cash/Credit).
* Manage the vendor payment process and shipment tracking.
* Coordinate with Gateway Operation Team for CFS stuffing containers \& consol.
* Collaborate with PCM team for carrier rates filing.
* Taking complete responsibility for independently managing customer accounts, guided by both supervisor and manager, following the 'one file, one operator' approach.
* Drive the implementation of sustainable environmental practices within the ocean freight operations, contributing to corporate social responsibility goals.

  

**Stakeholder Management**


* Enhance customer satisfaction by delivering exceptional services.
* Manage relationships with carriers, suppliers, and the network.
* Interface with the sales team and customer service team.

  

**Customer \& Network Support:**


* Enhance customer satisfaction through best\-in\-class services.
* Record complaints concerning all export shipments.
* Address and resolve network\-related issues.
* Maintain regular communication with sales and support teams.

  

**COMPETENCIES**


**Functional Competencies**


* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge of products, services, and logistics industry.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.

**Behavioral Competencies**


* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks and documentation.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high\-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues without waiting for direction.
* Team Collaboration: Collaborating across teams for smooth operations.

**WHO CAN APPLY?**


**Must Have**


* 2\-3 years of experience in the shipping/logistics industry for Executive/Sr. Exec.
* 4\-5 years of experience in the shipping/logistics industry for AM/DM
* Bachelor’s degree in any field.
* Proven experience in running smooth operations processes.
* Basic problem\-solving skills to address common challenges.
* Proficient in Email writing and verbal communication with internal and external coordination.

  

**Preferred**


* Courses and certifications in business administration, operations management.
* Completed Cargo Basic and Dangerous Goods courses.

  

**Qualified freshers are welcome.**

title: Software Engineer III
description:
**About Team:** 
  

  

 RX Global aims to create unforgettable experiences for attendees and exhibitors through organizing events. Innovation, creativity, and collaboration drive the company to offer exceptional services to clients.
   

  

**About the role:** 
  

  

 A Software Engineer III is an individual contributor who delivers production\-quality software for well\-defined components or features within a product or service. They work with guidance from senior engineers to translate requirements into maintainable, secure, and reliable systems that support customer and business outcomes. They are developing deeper knowledge of the systems within their team and contribute to engineering quality, operational health, and team collaboration while continuing to build their technical expertise.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Typically 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and contribute to production software systems
* Experience working in Agile cross\-functional product development teams
* Experience translating ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions
* Proficiency in one modern backend stack (.NET/C\# essential, Java or Node.js) plus familiarity with SQL/data skills
* Understanding of system design and domain modelling (SOLID, design patterns, API design)
* Experience writing unit/integration tests and CI/CD experience
* Cloud and DevOps exposure (preferably AWS), including observability and operational readiness
* Security\-minded approach aligned to Secure SDLC practices


**Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**
* Produces clear technical documentation using the process for technical decision making and RX architectural principles.
* Builds software with foundations in performance, resilience, extensibility, and security following the Secure SDLC
* Applies testing strategies that support deployment confidence and align with the Service \& Operational Level Agreements
* Contributes to incremental improvements to code quality, testing, or development workflows.
* Writes clean, maintainable code and participates actively in peer code reviews
* Learns and applies team standards, design patterns, and engineering practices.
* Solves well\-defined technical problems with support from more experienced engineers.
* Shares knowledge and learns from peers within the team.


**Operational Excellence**
* Supports the operational health of services and components within their team.
* Uses logs, monitoring, and metrics to help diagnose issues.
* Builds systems with operational considerations in mind, including reliability and recoverability.
* Participates in incident response and post\-incident reviews with guidance.
* Maintains runbooks, documentation, and operational knowledge for owned components.
* Contributes to reducing technical debt and improving maintainability in assigned areas.
* Ensures dependencies and security updates are applied to owned systems.
* Operational knowledge and awareness improve over time through hands\-on experience.


**Product Delivery \& Business Impact**
* Implements well\-defined requirements into working software features.
* Works with senior engineers to break down tasks and deliver incremental improvements.
* Delivers high\-quality software with predictable cycle times and low change failure rates under guidance.
* Collaborates with Product and Engineering to ensure solutions align with user and business outcomes.
* Raises delivery risks early and seeks guidance to resolve them.
* Contributes to simplifying implementation and improving code maintainability.
* Contributions support team delivery goals and product reliability


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Takes ownership of components or small features within a product or platform team.
* Communicates progress and technical topics clearly within the team.
* Seeks feedback and incorporates guidance from senior engineers and technical leads.
* Builds strong working relationships within the team and with close cross\-team partners.
* Demonstrates accountability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
* Begins mentoring more junior engineers or new team members where appropriate.


**Why join us?**
 You’ll play a key role in shaping robust, scalable platforms while influencing how technology is built at scale, engineering standards and delivery outcomes—working on systems that have measurable impact at scale. If you’re excited by leading product teams, shaping technology, and delivering software that matters, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**Work in a way that works for you** 
  

  

 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

**Working for you** 
  

  

 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

 Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
   

  

 Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
   

  

 Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
   

  

 Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
   

  

 Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance.
   

  

 Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges.
   

  

 Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority.
   

  

 Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
   

  

 Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
   

  

 New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
   

  

 Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
   

  

 Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazette Public Holidays.
   

  

  

  

**About Business:** 
  

  

 RX is a global leader in events and exhibitions, leveraging industry expertise, data, and technology to build businesses for individuals, communities, and organizations. With a presence in 25 countries across 41 industry sectors, RX hosts approximately 350 events annually. RX is committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all our people. RX empowers businesses to thrive by leveraging data\-driven insights and digital solutions. RX is part of RELX, a global provider of information\-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. For more information, visit www.rxglobal.com.
   

  

**We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

title: Junior Hardware Design Engineer
description:
We're looking for engineers who love figuring out how things work and aren't afraid to get hands\-on when things don't.
 



 If you enjoy turning a circuit idea into a working prototype, chasing down a noisy signal, or figuring out why a board isn't behaving as expected, you'll fit right in. We're building the electronic systems that power surgical robotics, where reliability, precision, and thoughtful engineering matter.
 



 As a Junior Hardware Design Engineer, you'll work across analog and power electronics, PCB design, prototyping, testing, and debugging \- taking designs from schematic to prototype and working closely with embedded, mechanical, and systems teams.
 



  





**What you'll actually be doing** 



* Designing analog circuits including op\-amps, filters, regulators, and signal\-conditioning circuits.
* Developing power electronics including DC\-DC converters, motor drivers, and power management systems.
* Creating schematics, selecting components, and developing multilayer PCB layouts.
* Building and testing prototypes, supporting PCB bring\-up, SMT implementation, and design iterations.
* Debugging hardware using oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, and other lab equipment.
* Conducting structured testing and root\-cause analysis to identify and resolve hardware issues.
* Implementing ESD, EMI, and EMC protection strategies for robust designs.
* Maintaining schematics, BOMs, PCB files, test reports, and other engineering documentation.
* Working closely with embedded, mechanical, and systems teams to integrate hardware into larger subsystems.
* Contributing to R\&D initiatives and exploring new hardware technologies.



  





**Who we're looking for** 



* You've got 0\-1 years of experience in hardware design, electronics, robotics, or a related field \- fresh graduates with strong hands\-on projects are welcome.
* You have a degree in Electrical, Electronics, ECE, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
* You understand the fundamentals of analog, digital, and power electronics.
* You're familiar with schematic capture and PCB design tools such as Altium, KiCad, or CAD, or similar.
* You're comfortable working with oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and other bench equipment.
* You've built or worked on hardware prototypes and enjoy getting from a schematic to something that actually works.
* You're curious, hands\-on, and the kind of person who wants to understand why something failed rather than simply work around it.



  





**What you get** 



* Real ownership and hands\-on exposure across the complete hardware development cycle.
* The opportunity to work across analog, power, embedded, mechanical, and systems domains.
* A front\-row seat to building reliable electronics for surgical robotics.
* A team that values curiosity, experimentation, and engineers who want to build, break, debug, and build better.

Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition. **Position Overview:**  

The Executive – Customer Service will be responsible for delivering high\-quality service to Blue Dart customers by handling inbound calls, resolving shipment\-related queries, coordinating timely pickups and deliveries, and ensuring adherence to defined customer service standards. The role also involves promoting sales opportunities through customer interactions and maintaining effective coordination with internal teams to enhance service delivery. **Job Purpose:**
To provide superior customer experience by handling inbound calls, resolving shipment queries, coordinating with operations teams for timely pickups and deliveries, and driving cross\-sales opportunities, while ensuring adherence to service quality parameters. **Key Roles \& Responsibilities:****Customer Interaction \& Query Resolution*** Handle inbound customer calls in line with defined standard operating procedures and service quality benchmarks.
* Record pickup requests accurately and coordinate with pickup staff for timely execution.
* Resolve customer queries related to shipment tracking, transit times, and delivery updates.
* Manage customer claims and complaints, ensuring coordination with operations for effective resolution, and escalate unresolved cases.

 **Sales \& Revenue Generation*** Conduct cross\-sales, TDD sales, and other customer service sales initiatives to meet defined sales targets.

 **Operational Coordination*** Actively liaise with the tracking team for shipment status updates and forward unresolved queries promptly.
* Ensure all pickup and delivery requests are managed within defined timelines.

 **Customer Service Excellence*** Maintain adherence to best\-in\-class customer service parameters across all interactions.

 **EMS*** Ensure that EMS is properly implemented and that environmental matters are properly handled at all stages
* The incumbent should be ISO 14001 :2015 trained or has a good awareness about Environmental initiatives/ ESG
* Should be able to handle environmental customer complaints smoothly

 **Qualifications \& Experience:****Education*** Essential: Graduate in any discipline.

 **Experience*** 1 \- 3 years of experience in customer service or contact centre operations (preferably in logistics/e\-commerce/retail).
* Freshers with strong communication skills may also be considered. Skills \& Capabilities:

 **Core Technical Skills*** Proficiency in handling customer service calls and CRM systems.
* Knowledge of shipment tracking processes and customer query resolution.
* Basic sales orientation with ability to cross\-sell products/services.

 **Behavioural Competencies*** Communication: Strong verbal communication and listening skills.
* Customer Centricity: Passion for delivering exceptional customer service.
* Problem\-Solving: Ability to resolve queries and escalate issues appropriately.
* Team Collaboration: Capability to coordinate effectively with cross\-functional teams. Key Performance Indicators:

 **Key Result Areas Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)****S. No.**

 **Key Result Areas**

 **KPIs**

  

1

  

Financial Performance

  

% revenue growth from assigned key accounts; cross\-sell revenue contribution

  

2

  

Customer Satisfaction

  

NSL scores; customer loyalty scores; % call\-back commitments met

  

3

  

Team Productivity

  

Average revenue per FTE; account\-wise performance improvement

  

4

  

Complaint \& Claim Handling

  

Adherence to TATs for complaint resolution; timely claim closure

  

5

  

Performance Culture

  

Adherence to performance management timelines and processes

  

6

  

Employee Engagement \& Retention

  

Employee satisfaction score; team attrition rate

 **Why join DHL Blue Dart?**  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
Here’s what makes us stand out:* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, global exposure, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* Best\-in\-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.**Disclaimer**: At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).
Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.
Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
We are looking for a **Marketing Executive** who can develop new customers, generate enquiries, follow up with existing and potential clients, and help increase sales.

**Job Role: Marketing Executive – Electrical Products**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Identify and approach new industrial customers and companies requiring transformers and electrical products.
* Generate new sales enquiries through telephone calls, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, visits and other marketing channels.
* Visit customers, industries, contractors, panel builders, OEMs, EPC companies and electrical consultants for business development.
* Understand customer requirements and coordinate with the technical/production team for quotations.
* Prepare and send quotations and follow up with customers until order confirmation.
* Maintain regular follow\-up with existing customers and develop long\-term business relationships.
* Search for new business opportunities, projects, tenders and industrial requirements.
* Develop customer database and maintain proper records of enquiries, quotations and orders.
* Coordinate with the production and dispatch team regarding customer requirements and delivery schedules.
* Collect market information regarding competitors, products, pricing and customer requirements.
* Achieve monthly sales and enquiry\-generation targets.
* Travel for customer visits within Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Kalyan\-Dombivli and other locations as required.

**Products to be Marketed:**

* Control Transformers
* Power Transformers
* Lighting Transformers
* Auxiliary Transformers
* Auto Transformers
* Variacs
* VFD Chokes
* Harmonic Chokes
* Detuned Reactors
* High Voltage Transformers
* Ignition Transformers
* Customized Electrical Transformers and Reactors

**Candidate Requirements:**

* Diploma/Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent qualification preferred.
* Experience in electrical/electronic industrial product sales or marketing will be preferred.
* Freshers with good communication and sales skills can also apply.
* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to communicate with industrial customers professionally.
* Basic knowledge of electrical products and transformers will be an advantage.
* Should be willing to travel for customer visits.
* Should be target\-oriented, confident and proactive.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Word, Email and WhatsApp.
* Valid driving licence and own two\-wheeler will be an advantage.
* **What We Are Looking For:** We are looking for a person who is willing to take initiative, find new customers and actively generate business. The candidate should be comfortable with calling customers, visiting industries, following up on enquiries and converting enquiries into orders.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: B2B Field Sales Executive
description:
**B2B Field Sales Executive – Bamboo Toothbrush \| Pune**

**Company:** Ganuja Products  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Department:** Sales \& Business Development  
**Experience:** 0–3 years in field sales / FMCG / retail sales preferred  
**Education:** 12th pass / Graduate  
**Salary:** ₹15,000–₹20,000 per month \+ attractive performance incentives  
**Travel:** Daily field visits across Pune

About the Role

Ganuja Products is expanding its distribution and retail network for its **Bamboo Toothbrush** and is looking for an energetic **B2B Field Sales Executive** to develop retailers and business customers across Pune.

You will visit retailers, introduce the product, take orders, develop new accounts and maintain relationships for repeat orders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Visit retailers and business outlets across assigned Pune areas.
* Introduce and sell Ganuja Bamboo Toothbrush to retailers.
* Develop new B2B customers and maintain existing accounts.
* Target organic stores, Ayurvedic stores, pharmacies, supermarkets, cosmetic/personal\-care stores, general stores and other suitable outlets.
* Explain product benefits, pricing and retailer margins.
* Take orders and coordinate with the company for order fulfilment.
* Follow up with retailers for repeat orders.
* Maintain daily visit and sales records.
* Identify new markets and potential distributors.
* Achieve monthly sales and customer\-acquisition targets.

**Product \& Retailer Offer**

**MRP :** ₹59 per piece  
**Retailer Purchase Price :** ₹35 per piece  
**Retailer Margin :** ₹24 per piece  
**Minimum Order Quantity :** Only 10 pieces

The low MOQ makes it easy for retailers to start with a trial order.

Sales Target

The initial objective is to develop the retailer network.

**Target after route development : 150\+ Bamboo Toothbrushes/day**

The target will be supported through retailer acquisition, repeat orders and territory development.

**Who We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who:

* Is comfortable with daily field sales.
* Can confidently approach new retailers.
* Has good communication and convincing skills.
* Is comfortable travelling throughout Pune.
* Can independently manage a sales route.
* Is result\-oriented and comfortable with sales targets.
* Has a two\-wheeler and valid driving licence — preferred.
* Has previous experience in FMCG, pharma, Ayurvedic, cosmetic, personal\-care or retail sales — preferred.

**Freshers with strong communication and sales ability can also apply.**

Why Join Us?

* Fixed salary \+ performance incentives.
* Opportunity to build a large B2B retailer network.
* Growing product category.
* Independent field\-sales role.
* Opportunity for higher earnings based on performance.
* Scope for growth into Territory Sales / Sales Executive / Sales Manager roles.

**Job Location :** Pune

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Business Development Executive - Seller Acquisition
description:
Business Development Executive \| Seller Acquisition

**Company:** TrueVolt  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Location:** Ahmedabad / Surat / Rajkot / Mumbai / Delhi  
**Department:** Sales \& Business Development  
**Experience:** 0–3 years  
**Employment Type:** On\-site / Field Sales

About TrueVolt

TrueVolt is building an open marketplace for smartphones, electronics, accessories and related products.

We connect local retailers and sellers with customers looking to purchase products in their area. Our platform helps sellers not only list their inventory but also generate sales by making their products discoverable to nearby customers through the TrueVolt app.

We are now expanding our seller network across major cities in India and are looking for energetic, target\-driven people to join our Sales \& Business Development team.

About the Role

As a **Business Development Executive for Seller Acquisition**, you will be responsible for expanding TrueVolt's seller network in your assigned city.

Your primary responsibility will be to identify potential sellers, visit their stores, explain the TrueVolt platform, onboard them, and build a strong relationship with them.

This is a **field sales role**, so you should be comfortable spending most of your working day in the market meeting shop owners and business owners.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and map potential sellers, retailers and mobile/electronics stores in your assigned territory.
* Visit shops and meet business owners / decision\-makers.
* Introduce TrueVolt and explain how the platform can help sellers generate additional sales.
* Acquire and onboard new sellers onto the TrueVolt platform.
* Explain the seller onboarding process, platform features and commercial terms.
* Collect and verify required seller/business information and documents.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with prospective sellers and convert leads into active sellers.
* Build strong relationships with onboarded sellers.
* Help sellers understand how to effectively use the TrueVolt platform.
* Maintain daily activity and sales reports.
* Achieve weekly and monthly seller acquisition targets.
* Identify new market opportunities and competitor activity.
* Work closely with the TrueVolt operations and growth teams to improve seller acquisition and activation.

What We Are Looking For

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable speaking with shop owners and business professionals.
* Good convincing and negotiation ability.
* Self\-motivated and target\-oriented.
* Comfortable with field work and travelling within the assigned city.
* Ability to independently identify and approach potential sellers.
* Basic knowledge of smartphones, electronics, mobile accessories or retail is an advantage.
* Prior experience in field sales, merchant acquisition, B2B sales, retail sales or business development is preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a sales mindset are also welcome.

Who Will Do Well in This Role?

This role is ideal for someone who:

* Enjoys meeting new people every day.
* Is comfortable approaching businesses directly.
* Doesn't hesitate to make cold calls or walk into stores.
* Can convince a business owner to try a new platform.
* Enjoys working with targets and incentives.
* Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.
* Wants to grow in a fast\-moving startup environment.

Performance Metrics

Your performance will primarily be measured on:

* New seller acquisition
* Seller activation
* Daily/weekly market visits
* Lead\-to\-onboarding conversion
* Active sellers generated
* Monthly sales/business targets

Compensation

**Salary:** ₹15000 – ₹30000 per month  
**Performance Incentives:** Additional incentives based on seller acquisition and performance.

**Total earning potential:** Salary \+ attractive performance\-based incentives.

*Compensation can be structured based on experience and performance.*

Growth Opportunity

TrueVolt is expanding across multiple cities in India.

High\-performing team members can grow into roles such as:

**Business Development Executive → Senior BDE → City Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager**

This is an opportunity to join the early sales team and play a direct role in building TrueVolt's seller network across India.

How to Apply

If you are energetic, ambitious, comfortable with field sales and excited about building something from the ground up, we'd like to hear from you.

**Apply now and become part of the TrueVolt growth team.**

**Location:** Ahmedabad / Surat / Rajkot / Mumbai / Delhi  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Mode:** Field Sales

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

title: Front Office Associate
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONFront Office Associate

**Hotel:** Grand Mercure Goa Candolim GOA  
**Group:** Accor  
**Department:** Front Office  
**Position:** Front Office Associate  
**Location:** Candolim, Goa  
**Reporting To:** Front Office Manager / Assistant Front Office Manager

1\. Job Purpose

To provide warm, efficient, and professional service to guests throughout their stay, ensuring a smooth and memorable guest experience in accordance with Grand Mercure and Accor brand standards, hotel policies, and service procedures.

The Front Office Associate will be responsible for handling guest arrivals and departures, reservations\-related coordination, guest requests, billing, communication, and other front office operations while maintaining high standards of hospitality and professionalism.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesGuest Service \& Experience

* Welcome and greet guests warmly using the hotel's standard greeting, **"Namaskar,"** with a pleasant smile and professional approach.
* Provide efficient and courteous check\-in and check\-out services.
* Assist guests with room information, hotel facilities, services, and local information.
* Handle guest requests, queries, and concerns promptly and professionally.
* Ensure guest satisfaction throughout their stay and follow up wherever required.
* Maintain a personalized approach while interacting with guests.
* Assist VIPs, repeat guests, long\-stay guests, and special\-category guests as required.
* Handle guest complaints professionally and escalate unresolved matters to the appropriate supervisor or manager.

Front Desk Operations

* Perform check\-in and check\-out procedures accurately and efficiently.
* Verify guest details, identification, registration cards, payment details, and other required documentation.
* Handle room key/card issuance and maintain proper control.
* Coordinate with Housekeeping regarding room status, room readiness, and special requests.
* Maintain accurate records of guest information and front office transactions.
* Handle wake\-up calls, messages, luggage\-related coordination, and other guest requests.
* Ensure proper handover of pending tasks and important guest information between shifts.

Cashiering \& Billing

* Handle guest bills, payments, deposits, and refunds as per hotel procedures.
* Ensure accuracy in posting charges and maintaining guest accounts.
* Handle cash, card, and other approved payment methods responsibly.
* Complete cashier closing and shift\-related documentation accurately.
* Report discrepancies immediately to the concerned supervisor/manager.

Communication \& Coordination

* Coordinate effectively with Housekeeping, F\&B, Engineering, Security, Reservations, Finance, and other departments.
* Communicate guest preferences, special requests, complaints, and important information to the concerned departments.
* Attend departmental briefings and ensure proper communication during shift handovers.
* Maintain professional telephone and email communication with guests and internal departments.

Accor \& Brand Standards

* Follow Accor and Grand Mercure service standards, SOPs, and operational procedures.
* Maintain professional grooming, personal hygiene, uniform standards, and overall appearance.
* Demonstrate the values of hospitality, respect, teamwork, and guest\-centric service.
* Participate in hotel training programs and continuously develop product and service knowledge.
* Maintain confidentiality of guest information and hotel\-related matters.

3\. Additional Responsibilities

* Assist during high\-occupancy periods, special events, group arrivals, and other operational requirements.
* Support other Front Office functions when required.
* Maintain cleanliness and organization of the front desk and guest\-facing areas.
* Be aware of hotel emergency procedures and follow safety and security guidelines.
* Report any suspicious activity, safety concern, maintenance issue, or guest\-related incident immediately.
* Perform any other duties assigned by the Front Office Manager or management in accordance with operational requirements.

4\. Required Skills \& Competencies

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Guest\-oriented and service\-focused approach.
* Good English communication skills; knowledge of additional languages is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to remain calm and professional while handling guest concerns.
* Good computer and basic hotel PMS knowledge.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* Good time\-management and organizational skills.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including night shifts, weekends, and public holidays.
* Professional grooming and positive attitude.

5\. Qualification \& Experience

**Education:**

* Diploma/Degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, or a related field preferred.

**Experience:**

* Freshers with relevant hospitality education may be considered.
* Previous experience in Front Office/Guest Relations in a hotel environment will be an advantage.

6\. Key Performance Areas (KPIs)

* Guest satisfaction and positive guest feedback.
* Efficient and accurate check\-in/check\-out process.
* Accuracy in billing and cashiering.
* Compliance with Accor and hotel SOPs.
* Effective handling and resolution of guest requests and complaints.
* Proper communication and coordination with other departments.
* Professional grooming and adherence to service standards.
* Teamwork and contribution to smooth Front Office operations.

7\. Working Conditions

* Rotational shifts as per hotel operational requirements.
* The position requires regular interaction with guests and other hotel departments.
* The associate may be required to stand and remain active for extended periods during the shift.
* Flexibility is required during peak occupancy, special events, and operational exigencies.

8\. Core Behavioural Expectations

The Front Office Associate is expected to demonstrate:

**Guest Focus \| Teamwork \| Professionalism \| Respect \| Accountability \| Positive Attitude \| Attention to Detail \| Communication \| Integrity**

**"Namaskar – with respect, warmth, and a smile."**

Pay: ₹14,500\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Goa, Goa: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* Front desk: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:
**Field Sales Executive – Magnifico Resins**

**Location:** Ahmedabad, Baroda, Rajkot  
**Department:** Sales  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Salary:** Starting ₹18,000/month \+ Incentives \+ Travel

**About Us**

Magnifico Resins is India's leading manufacturer of premium epoxy resins and Monocoat wood oils, trusted by 75,000\+ artists, furniture makers, and manufacturers across the country. Our products are known for crystal clarity, safety, and professional\-grade performance. As we expand our footprint across India, we're looking for driven Field Sales Executives to grow our dealer, distributor, and B2B network.

**Role Overview**

As a Field Sales Executive, you will be the face of Magnifico Resins in your territory, building relationships with hardware stores, furniture workshops, interior designers, art studios, and distributors, and driving consistent revenue growth through on\-ground sales activity.

Key Responsibilities

* Visit potential customers such as hardware/paint stores, furniture makers, interior designers, resin artists, and distributors within the assigned territory
* Convert clients into active, repeat\-purchasing customers
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing dealers/retailers to ensure repeat business and shelf visibility
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets
* Conduct product demonstrations and explain product benefits (0 VOC, UV resistance, self\-degassing technology, etc.)
* Collect market feedback, track competitor activity, and report insights to the sales manager
* Ensure timely follow\-ups, order collection, and coordination with the backend team for dispatch
* Maintain accurate records of visits, leads, and sales in daily/weekly reports

Requirements

* Minimum 12th pass / Graduate (any stream)
* 0–3 years of experience in field sales (freshers with strong communication skills may apply)
* Prior experience in FMCG, building materials, paints, chemicals, or hardware sales is a plus
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Self\-motivated, target\-driven, and comfortable with daily field travel
* Must own a two\-wheeler and a smartphone
* Local language proficiency (Gujarati/Hindi) plus working English

What We Offer

* Starting salary: ₹18,000/month (based on experience, negotiable for the right candidate)
* Attractive sales incentives on every target achieved
* Travel allowance (fuel/conveyance reimbursement)
* Opportunity to grow with one of India's fastest\-growing D2C manufacturing brands
* Training on product knowledge and sales techniques

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: From ₹18,000\.00 per month

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: On the road

Industry: Travel \& Tourism

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Track:** 
 Individual contributor
 



**Experience:** 
 0–2 years
 



**Team:** 
 Product, Onsurity Engineering
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 We're hiring an
 **Associate Product Manager** 
 to own well\-scoped features end to end,
 



 with guidance from senior PMs. This isn't a coordination role — you'll talk to members,
 



 look at the data, write the spec, argue for it in review, and stay with the feature after it
 



 ships. The problems you'll work on sit close to things that matter: a member's claim,
 



 their teleconsultation, their premium. Small features here have real consequences, and
 



 we want someone who feels that.
 



  





 You'll report to a Senior/Group PM and work daily with engineering, design, and data.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 ● Own a feature or small product area end to end — discovery through launch and iteration
 



 ● Write PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria clear enough that engineering doesn't need to guess
 



 ● Talk to members directly: interviews, surveys, usability sessions — and bring back what you actually heard, not what you expected to hear
 



 ● Read your own data — funnels, retention, adoption — and use it to make and
 



 defend decisions
 



 ● Sit in sprint planning, standups and reviews as a working partner to design and
 



 engineering, not a status\-taker
 



 ● Track competitors and the healthcare\-benefits market, and turn it into something the team can act on
 



 ● Coordinate launches with marketing, sales and support
 



 ● Triage feedback and bugs and push them to resolution
 



 ● Report progress and risk to stakeholders without needing to be asked
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





**Required** 




 ● 0–2 years in product, business analysis, consulting, engineering or similar
 



 (internships count)
 



 ● Bachelor's degree in any discipline
 



 ● Comfort with data — SQL, Excel/Sheets, or Mixpanel/Amplitude/GA
 



 ● Clear written and verbal communication
 



 ● Structured problem\-solving on ambiguous problems
 



 ● Genuine curiosity about users and how products actually work
 



 ● Ability to get things done cross\-functionally without formal authority
 



 ● Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) daily for research, writing and analysis — you know how to prompt well and how to check the output
 



  





**Nice to have** 




 ● Basic grasp of software development and Agile/Scrum
 



 ● Jira, Figma, Notion or Confluence
 



 ● Exposure to A/B testing
 



 ● A side project or case study that shows how you think about product
 



 ● Fintech, insurtech or healthtech exposure
 



  





**How We Work** 




 High ownership. Fast, but not reckless. Direct and low\-ego — disagree in the review,
 



 not after. You find the next useful thing to do without being told, and you say clearlywhen something's off track.
 



  





**This Role Isn't for You If** 




 You want a fully\-specified ticket queue instead of an ambiguous problem. You'd rather
 



 hand a feature off at launch than watch what happens to it after. You're not interested in
 



 talking to members directly.

**Job Description**

 Customer Success TEAMS
   

  





 NIQ GFK CMI’s Customer Success Team is focused on delivering world\-class insights and reports to the clients and striving for very high level of Customer Satisfaction and advocacy.
   

  





 Customer Success is NIQ GFK’s key department which is instrumental for the company’s success.

 You will be expected to understand our clients’ needs and then create and present solutions that help achieve their strategic and tactical goals.

* Information seeking: Curiosity and desire to know more about things, people, or issues. This involves going beyond routine questions and includes digging or pressing for exact information; resolving discrepancies by asking in\-depth questions.

Have the ability and propensity to recover quickly from setbacks, rejections, and conflicts and to maintain self\-control in the face of hostility or provocation.
* Organizational Savvy: Gather and accurately assess information related to the organization’s formal and informal communication channels and power relationships

 About you
   

  





 You are a high\-performing individual thriving in ensuring high client centricity \& customer satisfaction. You know that collaboration amongst teams and active listening of clients is critical to meet goals and grow.
   

  





  

  





 We are looking for people with:
   

  





  

  




* Graduate or Post Graduate with atleast 1\- 2 years of experience in data analysis and delivery

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Experience of working in an analytical environment

title: HR Manager
description:
**HR Policy \& Process Development**

* Frame, review, and update HR policies, procedures, and SOPs as per organizational requirements.
* Develop practical policies related to attendance, leave, employee conduct, recruitment, onboarding, performance, discipline, grievance handling, and separation.
* Identify gaps in existing HR processes and recommend improvements.
* Ensure policies are clearly communicated and implemented across departments.

**2\. Organizational Hierarchy Creation \& Implementation**

* Design and establish a clear organizational hierarchy and reporting structure in coordination with management.
* Define department\-wise roles, responsibilities, reporting lines, authority levels, and accountability.
* Develop and maintain organizational charts and ensure clarity regarding reporting relationships.
* Identify gaps, overlaps, and unclear responsibilities within the existing structure and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure the defined hierarchy is implemented practically across departments and followed in day\-to\-day operations.
* Work with department heads and management to ensure employees understand their roles, responsibilities, and escalation/reporting channels.
* Review the organizational structure periodically and recommend changes based on business growth and operational requirements.

**3\. Policy Implementation \& Employee Management**

* Take ownership of **on\-ground implementation and monitoring of HR policies**.
* Ensure employees and departments follow established HR processes and guidelines.
* Handle employee grievances, conflicts, disciplinary matters, and workplace issues.
* Maintain a professional, disciplined, and positive work environment.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in production planning, shop\-floor management, manpower coordination, material management, production documentation, and process improvement.

Key Responsibilities 1\. Production Planning \& Execution

* Plan and execute daily production activities based on production requirements and schedules.
* Coordinate with the production manager to achieve planned production volumes within the defined timelines.
* Monitor production activities throughout the shift and ensure smooth workflow.
* Allocate manpower and resources effectively based on production requirements.
* Ensure production is carried out according to approved processes, SOPs, and work instructions.
* Monitor production output and immediately report major deviations or delays to the reporting manager.

2\. Shop\-Floor Management

* Supervise day\-to\-day production activities on the shop floor.
* Ensure proper utilization of manpower, machines, materials, and other production resources.
* Monitor employee attendance, productivity, work allocation, and discipline within the production area.
* Ensure proper housekeeping and workplace organization in the production area.
* Identify operational issues and coordinate with the concerned teams for timely resolution.
* Maintain smooth coordination between shifts and ensure proper handover of pending activities.

3\. Manpower Management

* Allocate operators and workers according to production requirements.
* Monitor manpower availability and identify shortages that may affect production.
* Guide and support production staff in performing their assigned activities.
* Train employees on production procedures, SOPs, safety practices, and work instructions.
* Monitor employee performance and communicate recurring issues to the production manager.
* Ensure proper discipline and adherence to company policies within the production area.

4\. Raw Material \& Material Coordination

* Coordinate with stores and purchase teams to ensure timely availability of raw materials, packaging materials, and other production requirements.
* Verify material availability before starting production.
* Monitor material consumption against production requirements.
* Identify material shortages, excess consumption, wastage, or production\-related material issues.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of materials within the production area.
* Coordinate material movement between stores and Production.

5\. Production \& Quality Coordination

* Ensure production activities comply with defined quality standards and approved specifications.
* Coordinate with the Quality team for in\-process inspections and quality checks.
* Identify and report quality deviations during production.
* Support investigation of production\-related quality issues and implementation of corrective actions.
* Ensure rejected, damaged, or non\-conforming materials are properly identified and segregated.
* Follow approved SOPs and quality procedures during production activities.

6\. Machine \& Equipment Coordination

* Monitor the operational condition of production machinery and equipment.
* Coordinate with the maintenance team for machine breakdowns and technical issues.
* Report recurring machine problems that affect production efficiency.
* Ensure machines are operated safely and according to approved operating procedures.
* Support preventive maintenance activities by coordinating production requirements with the maintenance team.
* Ensure proper cleaning and basic upkeep of production equipment.

7\. Production Records \& Documentation

* Maintain accurate daily production records and reports.
* Record production quantity, rejection, wastage, downtime, manpower, and material consumption.
* Ensure proper completion of batch records, production sheets, checklists, and other required documents.
* Maintain shift\-wise production records and handover information.
* Ensure production documentation is complete, accurate, and available for review.
* Support preparation of daily, weekly, and monthly production reports.

8\. Production Reconciliation

* Reconcile planned production against actual production.
* Monitor raw material consumption against production output.
* Identify production variances, wastage, rejection, and process losses.
* Coordinate with Stores and Accounts/Finance teams wherever required for material and production reconciliation.
* Investigate significant variances and report findings to the production manager.

9\. Wastage \& Process Improvement

* Monitor production wastage and identify the reasons for excess wastage.
* Implement approved corrective actions to reduce material and process losses.
* Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency and reduce downtime.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives within the production process.
* Suggest practical improvements in workflow, manpower utilization, material handling, and production processes.

10\. Safety \& Compliance

* Ensure employees follow all applicable production safety procedures.
* Ensure appropriate use of PPE and other safety equipment.
* Report unsafe conditions, accidents, near misses, and safety concerns immediately.
* Maintain a safe and organized production environment.
* Ensure compliance with company SOPs, statutory requirements, and internal production policies.

11\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate with stores for raw material and packaging material requirements.
* Coordinate with Quality for inspections, testing, and quality\-related issues.
* Coordinate with Maintenance for machine breakdowns and preventive maintenance.
* Coordinate with Purchase for material availability and shortages.
* Coordinate with Planning/Sales for production requirements and schedules.
* Coordinate with HR regarding manpower availability, attendance, training, and disciplinary matters.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in **production, mechanical, industrial engineering, manufacturing, or a related field**.
* **2\+ years of experience** in production operations, manufacturing, or a similar role.
* Experience in handling production activities in a manufacturing environment.
* Practical knowledge of production planning and shop\-floor operations.
* Experience in manpower and material coordination.
* Good understanding of production processes, SOPs, quality requirements, and safety practices.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and team\-handling skills.
* Willingness to work in a manufacturing/production environment.

Preferred Skills

Bluebenz Digitizations is a technology and digital transformation company specializing in ERP Solutions, Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRP), AI Engineering, Data Engineering, Product Engineering, Digital Transformation, Business Intelligence (BI), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Cloud Solutions, and Custom Software Development.

We help manufacturing and industrial organizations improve operational efficiency, visibility, productivity, and business growth through innovative technology solutions.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic, ambitious, and result\-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive business growth by engaging directly with manufacturing companies, factories, industrial units, and corporate offices across Maharashtra.

The role involves identifying prospective clients, meeting key decision\-makers, understanding business challenges, presenting Bluebenz ERP and digital transformation solutions, arranging product demonstrations, and generating qualified business opportunities. The position requires extensive field travel across MIDCs and industrial clusters.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Lead Generation \& Prospecting

The candidate will actively visit industrial areas, MIDCs, factories, and manufacturing companies to identify new business opportunities. Responsibilities include generating leads through direct visits, networking, and referrals while maintaining a structured database of prospective clients.

The candidate will regularly interact with Managing Directors, Business Owners, Plant Heads, Factory Managers, Production Managers, Operations Heads, IT Managers, and Purchase Heads to introduce Bluebenz solutions and explore potential business opportunities.

2\. Business Development

The Field Sales Executive will promote Bluebenz ERP, MRP, Manufacturing Automation, AI, Business Intelligence, and Digital Transformation solutions to manufacturing organizations.

The role requires understanding customer challenges related to production planning, inventory management, process automation, reporting, and operational efficiency, and identifying opportunities for ERP implementation, manufacturing digitization, business intelligence, AI\-driven automation, and custom software development.

3\. Meetings \& Product Demonstrations

The candidate will schedule and conduct meetings with decision\-makers, present company solutions, and coordinate online or onsite product demonstrations with technical teams.

The role also includes participating in requirement\-gathering discussions and ensuring effective follow\-up with prospects to move opportunities through the sales cycle.

4\. Sales Pipeline Management

The candidate will maintain daily activity reports, update CRM records, track opportunities from lead generation to closure, and maintain an accurate sales pipeline.

Regular reporting, forecasting, and achievement of assigned business development targets will be a key part of the role.

5\. Relationship Building

Building long\-term relationships with industrial clients is critical to success in this position. The candidate will participate in industrial exhibitions, trade fairs, networking events, and industry association meetings to expand Bluebenz's market presence.

The role also involves developing referral networks and maintaining strong customer relationships that contribute to repeat business and future opportunities.

6\. Market Intelligence

The candidate will continuously monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and ERP adoption patterns within the manufacturing sector.

Insights gathered from customers and the market should be shared with management to support strategic business decisions and identify emerging opportunities.

**Performance Expectations**

The successful candidate is expected to maintain a strong field presence and consistently generate new business opportunities.

Expected activity levels include conducting approximately 8 to 12 factory visits per day, meeting 4 to 5 decision\-makers daily, adding at least 25 new prospects every week, maintaining a healthy sales pipeline, and contributing to monthly business opportunity generation targets.

**Educational Qualifications**

Applicants should possess a Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Computer Applications, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA in Marketing or Sales will be considered an added advantage.

**Experience Requirements**

Fresh graduates with strong communication skills, confidence, and a genuine interest in sales are encouraged to apply.

Candidates with 1 to 5 years of experience in ERP Sales, Software Sales, Industrial Sales, Manufacturing Solutions Sales, or B2B Sales will be preferred.

**Skills \& Competencies**

The ideal candidate should possess strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.

A basic understanding of ERP systems, manufacturing operations, inventory management, production planning, and business software solutions will be advantageous.

The candidate should be self\-motivated, target\-oriented, proactive, and capable of working independently in a field\-sales environment.

**Travel Requirements**

This position requires extensive travel across industrial regions including Pune MIDC, Chakan MIDC, Bhosari MIDC, Ranjangaon MIDC, Talegaon Industrial Area, Pimpri\-Chinchwad Industrial Belt, Satara, Kolhapur, Nashik, Aurangabad, Ahmednagar, and other industrial zones across Maharashtra.

Candidates must possess a two\-wheeler and should be comfortable with frequent local and regional travel.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

The compensation package will range from ₹XYZ to ₹ PQR per month depending on qualifications, experience, and performance.

In addition to fixed compensation, employees will be eligible for performance\-based incentives, travel allowance, fuel reimbursement, mobile allowance, performance bonuses, and career advancement opportunities.

**Senior Sales Executive**

**Business Development Manager**

**Regional Sales Manager**

**Sales Head**

**Why Join Bluebenz?**

Bluebenz offers an opportunity to work with leading manufacturing companies and contribute to their digital transformation journey. Employees gain exposure to ERP, AI, Automation, Business Intelligence, and Industrial Digitalization projects while enjoying a performance\-driven environment with significant career growth potential.

title: Executive Housekeeper
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONEXECUTIVE HOUSEKEEPER

**Hotel:** Okean De Goa  
**Department:** Housekeeping  
**Position:** Executive Housekeeper  
**Reports To:** General Manager / Operations Manager  
**Supervises:** Housekeeping Supervisors, Room Attendants, Housepersons, Public Area Attendants, Linen/Laundry Staff and other Housekeeping Team Members  
**Location:** Goa  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

1\. JOB PURPOSE

The Executive Housekeeper is responsible for the overall management and smooth operation of the Housekeeping Department at Okean De Goa.

The position is responsible for maintaining high standards of **cleanliness, hygiene, presentation, guest comfort and room readiness** throughout the hotel. The Executive Housekeeper will lead the housekeeping team, plan daily operations, conduct inspections, control inventory and linen, coordinate with other departments, and ensure that guest rooms and public areas are maintained according to the hotel's standards.

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. Housekeeping Operations

* Plan, organize and supervise the day\-to\-day operations of the Housekeeping Department.
* Ensure all guest rooms are cleaned, inspected and released on time for arrivals.
* Monitor departure rooms, stay\-over rooms, vacant rooms and priority rooms.
* Ensure corridors, lobby areas, public areas, staircases, back\-of\-house areas and other hotel premises are maintained properly.
* Prepare and implement daily cleaning schedules and deep\-cleaning schedules.
* Ensure housekeeping operations are properly managed during high\-occupancy periods.
* Coordinate room cleaning priorities according to arrivals, VIP guests, special requests and operational requirements.

B. Room Inspection \& Quality Control

* Conduct regular inspections of guest rooms and public areas.
* Ensure rooms meet Okean De Goa's required standards before releasing them to Front Office.
* Check cleanliness, linen, towels, amenities, bathroom condition, furniture, fixtures, lighting, AC condition and overall room presentation.
* Identify maintenance defects and immediately report them to the Maintenance/Engineering Department.
* Follow up on reported defects until they are resolved.
* Take corrective action whenever housekeeping standards are not maintained.
* Maintain consistent hygiene and cleanliness standards throughout the property.

C. Staff Management

* Supervise and manage the complete Housekeeping team.
* Prepare staff duty rosters, shifts, weekly offs and work allocations.
* Allocate rooms and cleaning duties according to occupancy and workload.
* Monitor staff attendance, grooming, discipline and performance.
* Conduct daily briefings and communicate operational priorities to the team.
* Train new employees on cleaning procedures, hotel standards, hygiene, safety and guest service.
* Conduct regular on\-the\-job training and refresher training.
* Motivate the team and maintain professional discipline within the department.
* Evaluate staff performance and recommend training or corrective action where required.

D. Front Office Coordination

* Maintain close coordination with the Front Office regarding room status.
* Ensure accurate and timely communication of **Vacant Clean, Vacant Dirty, Occupied, Out of Order and Out of Service** room status.
* Prioritize rooms according to expected arrivals and guest requirements.
* Coordinate early\-arrival rooms wherever operationally possible.
* Communicate room readiness to Front Office without unnecessary delay.
* Coordinate with Front Office regarding guest complaints, room changes, special requests and late check\-outs.

E. Linen \& Laundry Management

* Maintain proper control of bed sheets, pillow covers, towels, bath mats, blankets and other hotel linen.
* Maintain minimum and maximum/par stock levels.
* Conduct regular linen inventories and identify shortages or damages.
* Ensure proper handling, storage and movement of clean and soiled linen.
* Monitor laundry quality and turnaround time.
* Ensure damaged or condemned linen is properly recorded.
* Maintain proper records for linen movement and consumption.

F. Housekeeping Supplies \& Inventory

* Maintain adequate stock of cleaning chemicals, guest amenities, toiletries and housekeeping materials.
* Monitor daily consumption and avoid unnecessary wastage.
* Maintain proper housekeeping store records.
* Prepare purchase requisitions when stock reaches the required reorder level.
* Check the quality and quantity of supplies received.
* Ensure all chemicals and cleaning products are properly labelled, stored and handled safely.
* Maintain control over housekeeping equipment such as vacuum cleaners, mops, trolleys, cleaning machines and other tools.

G. Guest Service \& Complaints

* Ensure prompt response to guest requests related to housekeeping.
* Handle cleanliness\-related guest complaints professionally and ensure proper resolution.
* Coordinate room changes and additional cleaning requirements when necessary.
* Ensure VIP/special occasion rooms are prepared as per instructions.
* Maintain guest privacy and confidentiality at all times.
* Ensure Lost \& Found procedures are strictly followed and all items are recorded and handed over as per hotel policy.

H. Hygiene, Safety \& Security

* Ensure compliance with hotel hygiene and sanitation standards.
* Ensure safe handling and storage of cleaning chemicals.
* Ensure housekeeping staff use equipment and chemicals correctly.
* Maintain safe working practices to prevent accidents and injuries.
* Report unsafe conditions immediately to the concerned department.
* Ensure guest rooms and housekeeping areas are properly secured.
* Ensure master keys and room keys are handled strictly according to hotel policy.
* Ensure Lost \& Found items are handled and recorded properly.

I. Cost Control

* Monitor housekeeping departmental expenses.
* Control unnecessary consumption of chemicals, amenities, linen and other supplies.
* Minimize linen and inventory losses.
* Monitor staff productivity and manpower requirements according to occupancy.
* Reduce wastage without compromising cleanliness or guest satisfaction.
* Assist management in preparing the Housekeeping Department budget and operational requirements.

J. Coordination With Other Departments

Maintain effective coordination with:

* **Front Office** – Room status, arrivals, departures, room changes and guest requests.
* **Maintenance/Engineering** – Room defects, repairs and preventive maintenance.
* **F\&B Department** – Public area cleanliness and housekeeping requirements.
* **Security** – Lost \& Found, guest/property security and incidents.
* **HR** – Recruitment, attendance, training, discipline and employee matters.
* **Stores/Purchase** – Housekeeping supplies, chemicals, linen and equipment.
* **Management** – Daily operational issues, manpower, expenses and departmental performance.

3\. DAILY REPORTS \& RECORDS

The Executive Housekeeper shall ensure that the following records are properly maintained:

* Daily Housekeeping Report
* Room Status Report
* Room Inspection Checklist
* Housekeeping Duty Roster
* Staff Attendance Record
* Linen Inventory
* Laundry Record
* Housekeeping Stock/Inventory Record
* Cleaning Chemical Consumption Record
* Lost \& Found Register
* Maintenance/Defect Report
* Deep Cleaning Schedule
* Public Area Cleaning Schedule
* Guest Complaint/Request Record
* Purchase Requisition Records

4\. KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Guest room cleanliness and presentation
* Timely room readiness
* Public area cleanliness
* Guest feedback and housekeeping complaints
* Staff productivity and discipline
* Linen control and inventory accuracy
* Housekeeping supply and chemical cost control
* Reduction of wastage and damages
* Timely reporting and resolution of maintenance issues
* Staff training and grooming standards
* Compliance with hotel hygiene and safety procedures
* Effective coordination with Front Office and other departments

Pay: ₹23,000\.96 \- ₹35,000\.58 per month

**About Telosa**

Telosa is an AI\-powered customer experience platform for multi\-location brands — reputation, listings, lead capture, AI resolution and marketing in one dashboard. We work with enterprise clients across India, MENA and Southeast Asia. Small team, fast decisions, direct exposure to how a company gets built.

**The role**

This is the founder's support role for everything that keeps the company running — people, office, compliance — plus the coordination behind client renewals and the quality of what leaves Telosa in writing. It suits someone early in their career who is organised, versatile, and wants range rather than a narrow lane. You will learn by sitting close to the founder and being the person things route through.

**What you'll do**

*Human Resources*

* Coordinate hiring: post roles, source through portals and consultants, do first\-level screening calls, schedule interviews, and follow up with candidates through offer and joining.
* Run onboarding — documentation, appointment letters, induction, asset handover, first\-week experience — and handle exits with the same care.
* Maintain employee records, attendance and leave data; prepare the monthly payroll input for the founder's review.
* Keep HR policy documents current and be the first point of contact for everyday employee queries.
* Organise team events, the festival and birthday calendar, and review scheduling.

*Administration \& Office*

* Run the Baner office day to day: facilities, housekeeping, IT assets, supplies, vendor coordination and AMC renewals.
* Track statutory and compliance paperwork, registrations, insurance and licence renewals; coordinate with the CA and external consultants.
* Process invoices, reimbursements and petty cash; support finance on collections follow\-up.
* Arrange travel, accommodation and visa paperwork for the team.

*Client Renewals — coordination*

* Maintain the master contract tracker: every client, value, renewal date and notice period, always current.
* Flag renewals 60–90 days ahead and pull together the account's usage and outcome data with the customer success and product teams, so the founder walks in prepared.
* Push renewal documentation through to signature and track receivables against it.
* Raise early warning signs — client gone quiet, delayed payment, dropped usage.

*External Communications*

* Draft and manage correspondence going out under the founder's name: client and partner follow\-ups, meeting notes, action trackers, investor update inputs.
* Manage the founder's calendar and prepare briefing notes ahead of external meetings.
* Own the shared inboxes and coordinate outbound comms with the marketing team.
* Keep decks, proposals and templates versioned and presentable.

**What we're looking for**

* 1\+ year of experience in HR, executive assistance, business operations, client servicing or a similar coordination role. Strong internship experience counts.
* High ownership. Chases things to closure without reminders, keeps confidences, and holds several unrelated threads in a day without dropping any.
* Genuinely strong written English. You will be drafting on behalf of the founder; the writing has to land without correction.
* Graduate in any discipline; an MBA/PGDM in HR is welcome but not required.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint and business email, and quick to pick up new tools.
* Presentable and composed with senior external stakeholders — clients, investors, partners, vendors.

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to payroll, statutory compliance or contract administration.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS, startup or agency environment.

**What you get**

* A direct line to the founder and visibility into every part of the business — hiring, clients, fundraising, operations. Rare at this stage of a career.
* Real ownership from month one, not a filing job.
* Compensation as per experience.
* Baner, Pune. On\-site, Monday to Friday.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Quality Control Assistant (QC Assistant)

**Department:** Quality Control  
**Designation:** Quality Control Assistant  
**Reporting To:** QC Officer / QC Executive / QC Manager  
**Industry:** Pharmaceutical / API Manufacturing  
**Experience:** 0–3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** turbhe

1\. Job Purpose

To support routine Quality Control activities including sampling, testing, documentation, laboratory housekeeping, and maintenance of laboratory records in accordance with **GMP, GLP, approved SOPs, specifications, and company quality standards**.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Laboratory Testing

* Assist in routine testing of **raw materials, intermediates, APIs, finished products, and other samples** as per approved specifications and SOPs.
* Perform basic chemical and physical analysis under the supervision of senior QC personnel.
* Prepare samples, reagents, solutions, and standards as required.
* Record test results accurately in laboratory worksheets, registers, and analytical records.
* Inform the senior QC personnel immediately of any abnormal or unexpected results.

B. Sampling

* Assist in sampling of raw materials, packing materials, intermediates, and finished products as per approved sampling procedures.
* Ensure proper labeling and identification of samples.
* Maintain sample traceability and transfer samples to the laboratory as per procedures.

C. Laboratory Documentation

* Maintain analytical worksheets, logbooks, registers, and other QC records.
* Follow **Good Documentation Practices (GDP)** while recording laboratory activities.
* Ensure all entries are accurate, legible, complete, and traceable.
* Maintain records of reagent and standard preparation, usage, and expiry.

D. Instruments \& Equipment

* Assist in operation of laboratory instruments under supervision.
* Ensure instruments are clean and properly maintained.
* Record equipment usage and maintain instrument logbooks.
* Inform senior personnel about equipment malfunction or abnormal performance.
* Support calibration and preventive maintenance activities.

E. Reagents \& Solutions

* Prepare laboratory reagents, volumetric solutions, buffers, and other solutions as per approved procedures.
* Properly label all prepared solutions with preparation date, expiry/retest date, and other required details.
* Maintain records of preparation and standardization where applicable.
* Ensure expired or unsuitable reagents are identified and disposed of according to procedures.

F. GMP / GLP Compliance

* Follow applicable **GMP, GLP, SOPs, safety requirements, and laboratory procedures**.
* Maintain cleanliness and housekeeping of the laboratory.
* Ensure proper handling, storage, and disposal of chemicals and laboratory waste.
* Report any deviation, abnormal observation, or safety concern to the supervisor.

G. Stability \& Retention Samples

* Assist in collection, labeling, storage, and retrieval of stability samples.
* Maintain stability sample records and storage conditions.
* Assist in management of retention samples as per approved procedures.

H. Audit \& Inspection Support

* Support preparation of laboratory documents and records for internal audits, customer audits, and regulatory inspections.
* Ensure laboratory records are readily available and properly maintained.
* Assist in addressing routine audit observations under the guidance of senior QC personnel.

3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy and completeness of analytical records.
* Timely completion of assigned testing activities.
* Compliance with GMP/GLP and SOP requirements.
* Proper maintenance of laboratory records and logbooks.
* Correct preparation and labeling of reagents and solutions.
* Laboratory housekeeping and safety compliance.
* Proper handling and traceability of samples.

4\. Educational Qualification

**Essential:**

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in **Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, or a related field**.

**Preferred:**

* B.Pharm / Diploma in Pharmacy or relevant laboratory qualification.
* Basic knowledge of analytical laboratory practices.

5\. Experience

* **0–3 years of relevant experience** in Quality Control / Analytical Laboratory in a pharmaceutical, API, chemical, or related manufacturing industry.
* Freshers with relevant educational qualifications may also be considered.

6\. Technical Knowledge

* Basic knowledge of pharmaceutical/API analysis.
* Understanding of laboratory safety practices.
* Basic knowledge of:
* pH meter
* Analytical balance
* UV\-Visible spectrophotometer
* HPLC/GC – basic exposure preferred
* Karl Fischer – basic exposure preferred
* Melting point / physical testing equipment
* Knowledge of GMP, GLP, GDP, and laboratory SOPs.

7\. Required Competencies

* Attention to detail
* Good laboratory practices
* Accuracy in documentation
* Basic analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Good communication skills
* Teamwork
* Time management
* Willingness to learn
* Safety\-conscious approach
* Quality\-focused mindset

8\. Reporting \& Coordination

**Reports To:** QC Officer / QC Executive / QC Manager

**Coordinates With:**  
Quality Assurance \| Production \| Warehouse \| R\&D \| Engineering \| EHS

9\. Overall Responsibility

The **Quality Control Assistant** is responsible for supporting laboratory testing, sampling, documentation, equipment handling, reagent preparation, and other QC activities while ensuring compliance with **GMP, GLP, approved SOPs, specifications, safety requirements, and company quality standards**.

This is a full\-time, on\-site Full Stack Developer – Fresher role located in Cherlapally, Hyderabad, Telangana. The role involves working across front\-end, back\-end, database, API integration, and application development tasks.

The candidate will primarily work with React.js, Next.js, and React Native, along with MySQL and NoSQL databases, REST APIs, Git, and Figma. * Basic understanding of cloud hosting and application deployment

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain responsive web applications using React.js and Next.js.
* Develop and maintain cross\-platform mobile applications using React Native.
* Build and integrate REST APIs with frontend and mobile applications.
* Work with MySQL and NoSQL databases for data storage and retrieval.
