title: Testing & Support Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Testing \& Support Engineer**

**Company:** Meteoxperts Solution Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Technical Support / Testing \& Service  
**Position:** Testing \& Support Engineer  
**Location:** Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Testing \& Support Engineer** to join our technical team. The candidate will be responsible for testing, troubleshooting, installation support, commissioning, maintenance, and technical support of **solar weather monitoring systems (WMS), sensors, data loggers, communication devices, and related field equipment**.

The role requires both **technical troubleshooting skills and good communication**, as the engineer will coordinate with customers, site engineers, OEMs, calibration teams, and internal R\&D teams to resolve technical issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Sensor \& Equipment Testing**

* Testing and verification of different sensors used in Solar WMS systems.
* Testing of:
* GHI / DHI / DNI Pyranometers
* PCCD sensors
* Rain Gauges
* Temperature Sensors
* Relative Humidity \& Temperature Sensors (ATRH)
* Wind Speed \& Wind Direction Sensors
* Atmospheric Pressure Sensors
* Module Temperature Sensors
* Soiling Sensors
* Lightning / related monitoring equipment
* Verify sensor outputs such as **0–5 V, 1–5 V, pulse/frequency and RS485/Modbus**.
* Perform basic sensor calibration checks and output verification.

**2\. Data Logger \& Communication Troubleshooting**

* Testing and troubleshooting of data loggers and WMS systems.
* Configure and troubleshoot **RS485, Modbus RTU, TCP/IP and Ethernet communication**.
* Check sensor communication using tools such as **Modbus Poll** and other diagnostic software.
* Troubleshoot communication parameters including:
* Slave ID
* Baud Rate
* Parity
* Stop Bits
* Register Address
* Timeout
* Response delay
* Troubleshoot GSM/GPRS/4G and network\-related communication issues.
* Basic understanding of **TCP, HTTP, FTP and MQTT** communication.

**3\. Installation \& Site Support**

* Provide technical support during WMS installation and commissioning.
* Verify sensor wiring, polarity, grounding, termination, and communication connections.
* Support site engineers during troubleshooting activities.
* Conduct remote troubleshooting sessions with customers and site teams.
* Travel to project sites when required for installation, testing, inspection or troubleshooting.

**4\. Fault Finding \& Root Cause Analysis**

* Analyze sensor and logger data to identify abnormal readings.
* Perform systematic troubleshooting of hardware and communication issues.
* Identify probable root causes and recommend corrective actions.
* Coordinate with OEMs for unresolved technical issues.
* Follow up with OEMs until the issue is resolved.
* Maintain records of complaints, troubleshooting activities and final resolutions.

**5\. Testing \& Quality Verification**

* Perform incoming and outgoing inspection of sensors and equipment.
* Verify equipment functionality before dispatch to site.
* Conduct testing after repair/replacement.
* Prepare testing reports and inspection reports.
* Verify sensor readings against expected/reference values.
* Support calibration\-related activities and coordinate with calibration teams.

**6\. Technical Documentation**

* Prepare:
* Service reports
* Testing reports
* Inspection reports
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Troubleshooting reports
* Site visit reports
* Customer/OEM communication
* Maintain proper records of equipment, serial numbers, test results and service history.
* Update support logs and pending\-action status.

**7\. Customer \& OEM Coordination**

* Communicate professionally with customers and site engineers.
* Understand technical complaints and collect required information.
* Coordinate with OEMs for technical investigations.
* Provide customers with regular updates regarding issue status.
* Prepare professional technical emails and service communications.

**8\. Data Analysis \& Excel**

* Download and analyse data received from WMS sensors and data loggers.
* Analyse historical and real\-time sensor data to identify abnormal readings, missing data, zero values, spikes, fluctuations and communication gaps.
* Perform **daily, monthly and period\-wise data analysis**.
* Calculate and verify sensor parameters, averages, minimum/maximum values, ratios and other required parameters.
* Analyse **soiling ratio and sensor performance data** where applicable.
* Compare data between different sensors, channels, sites or reference instruments.
* Identify trends and abnormalities from large datasets.
* Prepare Excel\-based analysis sheets and technical summaries.
* Maintain and update data tracking sheets for ongoing technical issues.
* Use Excel for sorting, filtering, calculations, conditional checks, charts and data presentation.
* Verify data accuracy before preparing customer reports.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Must Have**

* Basic knowledge of **electrical and electronics troubleshooting**.
* Understanding of **DC voltage, current, resistance and signal measurement**.
* Knowledge of **multimeter and basic testing instruments**.
* Basic understanding of **RS485 and Modbus RTU**.
* Understanding of analog signals such as **0–5 V and 1–5 V**.
* Basic computer and Windows troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to read wiring diagrams and technical datasheets.
* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving ability.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with **Solar WMS / weather monitoring systems**.
* Experience with **data loggers**.
* Knowledge of **Modbus Poll**.
* Knowledge of **GSM/GPRS/4G communication**.
* Basic knowledge of **TCP/IP, HTTP, FTP and MQTT**.
* Experience with **Ethernet/TCP Modbus**.
* Knowledge of sensor calibration and measurement principles.
* Basic programming knowledge or experience with logger programming.
* Experience working with **Campbell Scientific, Sutron or similar data loggers** is an advantage.

**Tools \& Instruments**

The candidate may work with:

* Digital Multimeter
* DC Power Supply
* RS485\-to\-USB Converter
* USB\-to\-Serial Converter
* Modbus Poll
* Laptop/PC
* Network tools
* Data Loggers
* Sensor calibration/testing equipment
* Basic electrical and electronic testing equipment

**Educational Qualification**

**Diploma / B.Tech / B.E.** in:

* Electronics \& Communication Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Instrumentation Engineering
* Electronics Engineering
* Mechatronics
* Any related technical field

**Soft Skills**

* Good communication skills.
* Good technical documentation skills.
* Ability to communicate with customers and OEMs professionally.
* Willingness to travel to project sites.
* Good troubleshooting and analytical thinking.
* Ability to work independently as well as with a technical team.
* Willingness to learn new sensors, loggers and communication technologies.

**Key Performance Areas**

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Resolve technical support issues efficiently.
* Perform accurate sensor and equipment testing.
* Minimize repeat complaints through proper root\-cause analysis.
* Maintain proper testing and service documentation.
* Provide timely customer and OEM updates.
* Support successful installation and commissioning of WMS systems.

**Experience**

**Preferred:** 1–3 years in technical support, testing, instrumentation, electronics, solar WMS, data logging, field service or a related field.

**Freshers with strong knowledge of electronics, sensors, RS485/Modbus and troubleshooting may also be considered.**

**Additional Requirements**

* Willingness to travel to solar project sites.
* Valid driving license is an advantage.
* Comfortable working in field/site environments.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Word and email communication.

**Reporting**

**Reports To:** Technical Support / Service Manager

**Work Environment**

The position involves a combination of:

**Office Testing \+ Customer Support \+ Remote Troubleshooting \+ Field/Site Visits**

title: Backend Engineer (Hospital Management Systems)
description:
**We're Hiring: Backend Engineer (HMS)** 
 – MedOrbit, an AI\-Native Hospital Platform
 



  





 This isn't a "maintain a CRUD app" role. MedOrbit is already live with paying hospitals, runs the full clinical and operational spine of a hospital, and has 11 AI agents in production under clinician control. You'll build the backend that doctors, nurses, lab technicians, pharmacists and billing teams use every day.
 



  





**Role Details** 




 Position: Backend Engineer (Hospital Management Systems)
 



 Location: Nagarabhavi, Bangalore (On\-site, 5 days a week)
 



 Type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 0–2 years
 



 Joining: Immediate joiners strongly preferred
 



 Mandatory: Hands\-on experience developing a Hospital Management System (HMS), EHR/EMR, LIS, pharmacy or other healthcare software (job, internship or substantial project)
 



  





**About MedOrbit** 




 MedOrbit (by AI Nexus Innovations Hub) is a multi\-tenant hospital management platform built for Indian healthcare. One codebase serves 24 facility types, from a solo doctor's clinic to a 500\-bed super\-specialty hospital, pathology labs, imaging centres, dialysis chains, blood banks and retail pharmacies.
 



  





 It covers OPD, IPD, OT, Emergency, NICU, maternity, LIS / RIS / PACS, teleradiology, telemedicine, pharmacy, billing, revenue\-cycle management and insurance / TPA. It is ABDM\-integrated (ABHA, consent, HIP/HIU, FHIR R4\), NHCX\-connected for claims, HL7 and DICOM interoperable, and supports NABH/NABL evidence and DPDP compliance.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



  





 1️⃣ Core HMS Modules
 



 → Build and extend Java / Spring Boot microservices across patient registration, appointments, OPD/IPD workflows, bed management, lab orders, pharmacy inventory, billing and insurance claims
 



 → Design REST APIs and database schemas that work across 24 facility types without forking the codebase
 



 → Implement module licensing and multi\-tenant data isolation so each hospital sees only what it has licensed
 



  





 2️⃣ Healthcare Integrations
 



 → Work on ABDM flows: ABHA creation/linking, consent management, HIP/HIU data exchange
 



 → Build and maintain FHIR R4 resources, HL7 messages from lab analysers, and DICOM integration with PACS
 



 → Support NHCX claim submission and TPA workflows
 



  





 3️⃣ AI Integration
 



 → Integrate Python\-based AI services (ambient scribe, lab report intelligence, X\-ray analysis, claim\-denial guard) into the core platform
 



 → Build the APIs, queues and audit trails that let AI outputs appear inside doctor workflows, with clinician approval recorded every time
 



  





 4️⃣ Reliability \& Compliance
 



 → Write unit and integration tests, review code, and fix production issues quickly
 



 → Build audit logs, role\-based access control, consent tracking and data\-erasure features for DPDP and NABH compliance
 



 → Optimise queries and APIs for hospitals with high daily patient volumes
 



  





 Tech Stack
 



 Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, PostgreSQL / MySQL, Redis, Kafka / RabbitMQ, Python (AI services), Docker, AWS, Git, CI/CD
 



  





 What You Bring
 



  





**Must\-Have:** 




 → B.Tech / B.E. / M.Tech / MCA in Computer Science or related field (2024–2026 batches welcome)
 



 → Hands\-on experience building an HMS, EHR/EMR, LIS, RIS, pharmacy or clinic management system. Be ready to walk us through the modules you built, the database design, and the problems you solved
 



 → Strong fundamentals in Java and Spring Boot
 



 → Good understanding of REST APIs, SQL, joins, indexing and data modelling
 



 → Understanding of hospital workflows: patient registration → consultation → orders → billing → discharge
 



 → Working knowledge of Git, Docker and Linux
 



 → Clear communication – you'll work with doctors and hospital staff, not just engineers
 



  





 Nice\-to\-Have (Bonus Points!):
 



 → Exposure to FHIR, HL7, DICOM, ABDM, LOINC or ICD codes
 



 → Microservices architecture, Kafka / RabbitMQ, Redis caching
 



 → AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) and CI/CD pipelines
 



 → Experience with insurance/TPA billing or GST\-compliant invoicing
 



 → Basic Python or experience integrating ML/LLM services
 



 → Frontend exposure (React / Angular) for full\-stack debugging
 



  





**How We Work** 




 Small team, short decision path, direct access to the founders. Specifications are written down and taken seriously. We ship continuously to a live production platform, and features are validated with real hospital users, not in a conference room.
 



  





 Why Join AI Nexus?
 



 ✅ Build a live HMS used by real hospitals from Day 1
 



 ✅ Work on India's healthcare digital stack: ABDM, FHIR, NHCX
 



 ✅ See how AI agents are built into a production hospital platform
 



 ✅ Fast\-track career growth in a high\-potential health\-tech startup
 



  





 Please Include in Your Application
 



 → Primary skills:
 



 → HMS / healthcare software experience (mandatory): modules you built, tech stack, your role; GitHub / demo link:
 



 → Total experience:
 



 → Current CTC / Expected CTC:
 



 → Notice period / How soon can you join?:
 



 → Current location:
 



 → Available for an interview this week? Preferred date and time:
 



 → On\-site role, 5 days a week, at our Nagarabhavi office (Map: https://share.google/H9bvX6kY5dka4v7Ob). Can you commute daily? Yes / No
 



  





 📩 Send your resume to: raju@thenexushub.ai
 



 🌐 https://www.ainexushub.ai/ \| https://medorbit.ai
 



  




* \#Hiring \#BackendEngineer \#Java \#SpringBoot \#Microservices \#HMS \#HospitalManagementSystem \#HealthTech \#EHR \#FHIR \#HL7 \#ABDM \#AWS \#Bangalore \#Nagarabhavi \#ImmediateJoiner \#StartupJobs

title: Junior Electrical Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a **Junior Electrical Engineer** with a Diploma in Electrical Engineering and 0–1 year of practical experience in electrical panel assembly, wiring and testing.

The candidate should have a basic understanding of electrical components and hands\-on exposure to **panel wiring, cable termination, busbar fabrication and testing**. The role will involve assisting in the manufacturing, assembly, wiring and testing of electrical panels and industrial electrical equipment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Electrical Panel Wiring \& Assembly**

* Carry out electrical panel wiring as per circuit diagrams and wiring schedules.
* Understand and follow electrical schematics, GA drawings and wiring diagrams.
* Mount and connect electrical components such as MCBs, MCCBs, contactors, relays, terminals, meters and other control components.

**2\. Cable Crimping \& Termination**

* Cut and prepare cables according to required lengths.
* Perform cable stripping and crimping using appropriate tools.
* Select and install suitable **cable lugs, ferrules and glands**.

**3\. Busbar Fabrication**

* Carry out **busbar cutting, punching and bending** as per drawings and dimensions.
* Perform busbar drilling/punching accurately.
* Carry out **busbar tinning** wherever required.

**4\. MCB / MCCB Termination**

* Terminate incoming and outgoing cables on **MCBs and MCCBs**.
* Understand basic ratings and selection of MCBs/MCCBs.

**5\. Testing \& Inspection**

* Assist in testing electrical panels and equipment after assembly.
* Perform basic **continuity, insulation resistance and functional testing** using appropriate test instruments.

**6\. Production \& Quality**

* Follow production drawings, BOMs, work instructions and quality procedures.
* Maintain proper housekeeping and safe working practices.
* Coordinate with design, production and quality teams to resolve assembly issues.

**Required Technical Skills**

The candidate should have basic practical knowledge of:

* Electrical panel wiring
* Reading electrical wiring diagrams
* MCB and MCCB termination
* Cable stripping and crimping
* Selection and use of cable lugs and ferrules
* Busbar cutting
* Busbar punching/drilling
* Busbar bending
* Busbar tinning
* Electrical component identification
* Continuity testing
* Insulation resistance testing
* Basic electrical safety

**Preferred Skills**

* Hands\-on experience in **electrical panel manufacturing**
* Exposure to **industrial battery chargers, LV panels, DCDBs or control panels**
* Knowledge of electrical control circuits
* Familiarity with multimeter and insulation resistance tester (Megger)
* Ability to read and understand electrical drawings
* Good practical/technical aptitude
* Willingness to learn and work on the shop floor

**Candidate Profile**

* Diploma in Electrical Engineering.
* **Fresher to 1 year of experience** in electrical panel manufacturing, electrical assembly or a similar industrial environment.
* Should be comfortable with hands\-on electrical work.
* Should have good understanding of basic electrical concepts.
* Should be disciplined, safety\-conscious and willing to learn.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team.

**Key Performance Expectations**

* Accurate panel wiring and component termination.
* Good quality cable crimping and termination.
* Accurate busbar fabrication.
* Correct implementation of electrical drawings.
* Minimal wiring/rework errors.
* Timely completion of assigned production work.
* Compliance with electrical safety and quality standards.

**Salary**

**Salary:** To be discussed based on qualification, practical skills and experience.

**Preferred candidates:** Diploma Electrical Engineers with hands\-on exposure to panel wiring, electrical assembly and testing.

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

You will gain hands\-on experience with modern software delivery practices, cloud technologies, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, and developer tooling.
 



 This position provides an exceptional opportunity to learn how large\-scale engineering organizations operate while helping create a world\-class developer experience for engineering teams across the company.

title: DevOps Engineer II
description:
**About Neo** 




  





 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia**
 — Co\-Founder of
 
 Zeta
 
 ,
 
 Radix
 
 , and
 
 Titan
 
 —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 


* **Tasket** 
 — A radically reimagined, AI\-native, work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
* **Friday** 
 — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
* **Studio** 
 — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
* **Drive** 
 — AI\-native repository, where humans and agents can co\-work on files.
* **Scribe** 
 — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.



  





**About the Role** 




 As a DevOps Engineer, you will build and operate the infrastructure and delivery platform behind the Neo suite — cloud, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and the path to production — working closely with senior engineers who set the architecture and standards.
 



 We are proponents of leveraging best\-in\-breed AI tools at every step of the engineering lifecycle — design, development, review, and testing. This requires a different engineering mindset: a lean team of hands\-on, AI\-adept engineers, resulting in ultra\-rapid iteration cycles and fast output. You will apply this approach every day, using agents to move faster while owning the quality of what ships.
 



 At Neo, the platform serves both people and a growing fleet of agents shipping change in parallel. This role is for an engineer with strong fundamentals who wants real production ownership and a steep learning curve.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Cloud \& infrastructure** 



* Build, operate, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS/GCP/Azure, following the architecture and security standards set by the team.
* Write and maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform; contribute to reusable modules and keep an eye on cost and performance.



**Delivery \& GitOps** 



* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines as code; improve build speed, reliability, and quality checks on the path to production.
* Operate GitOps\-based deployments with Argo CD / Flux, and run rolling, canary, and blue\-green releases.



**Containers \& Kubernetes** 



* Deploy, run, and troubleshoot workloads on production Kubernetes — manifests and Helm charts, ingress (NGINX/Kong), autoscaling, and resource tuning.



**AI\-first delivery** 



* Use agentic tooling day to day to write, review, and test infrastructure code and automation — and validate what agents produce before it ships.
* Contribute to the guardrails and CI quality gates (linting, policy checks, plan reviews, scanning) that let engineers and agents ship safely.



**Reliability \& observability** 



* Set up and maintain dashboards, alerts, logs, and traces for the services you support.
* Participate in on\-call; triage and resolve incidents, and contribute to root\-cause analysis and follow\-up fixes.



**Security \& automation** 



* Apply cloud security best practices — least\-privilege IAM, secrets management, and image and dependency scanning.
* Write scripts and small tools in Python, Go, or Bash to automate repetitive operational work; document runbooks and share what you learn.



  





**Skills** 



* **AI\-native engineering practice** 
 — Uses agentic tooling across the lifecycle and builds the reusable modules, automation, and CI quality gates that make both human and agent\-authored infrastructure change safe to ship.
* **Systems \& networking** 
 — Solid Linux fundamentals (processes, filesystems, permissions, systemd, logs) and networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/TLS, load balancing, subnets and routing); comfortable debugging from the command line.
* **Cloud** 
 — Hands\-on with at least one major cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure): compute, VPC networking, IAM, storage, and managed databases.
* **Containers \& Kubernetes** 
 — Docker and image builds; hands\-on with Kubernetes objects (Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps/Secrets, HPA) and Helm or Kustomize.
* **CI/CD \& GitOps** 
 — Has built or maintained pipelines in tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins; working exposure to Argo CD or Flux.
* **Infrastructure as Code** 
 — Terraform (modules, remote state, plan/apply workflows); Ansible a plus.
* **Observability** 
 — Working knowledge of metrics, logging, and tracing tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, OpenTelemetry); can use them to debug a live issue.
* **Security basics** 
 — IAM, secrets management (e.g. Vault or cloud secret managers), and secure CI/CD practices.
* **On\-call \& Incident Response** 
 — Experience in an on\-call rotation or hands\-on incident response.
* **Programming \& automation** 
 — Writes clean, reviewable Python, Go, or Bash for automation and tooling.



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* 2\+ years of relevant experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or related roles.
* Software engineers with a bent towards Operations engineering or vice versa.
* Solid fundamentals in Linux/OS internals, networking, and system performance.
* Hands\-on experience with public or private cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar).
* Good understanding of distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven experience with modern CI/CD practices, GitOps workflows, and deployment strategies.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and configuration management using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Programming or scripting proficiency in Python, Go, or Bash.
* Has been part of a production on\-call rotation and has participated in incident response.
* Continuous learner with a strong ownership mindset and effective engineering practices.
* B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science or equivalent.



  





**Equal Opportunity** 




 Neo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

title: Cyber Triage And Forensic Junior Analyst
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Junior Security Analyst \-Cyber Defense CTF (Cyber Triage and Forensics)**
 Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of almost 950 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team helps protect the EY brand and build client trust.
   

  

 Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security\-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Cyber Triage and Forensics (CTF) \- The Cyber Defense Response Center is responsible for monitoring and detecting information security events that could adversely impact EY information assets and resources. Its mission is aligned with the both the incident response and attack lifecycles
   

  

 A qualified candidate will have the opportunity to work with highly talent Cyber security professional experts to learn and develop new skills. Candidate will be exposed to many technologies and security tools whilst working with EY as well as career growth opportunity. CTF also deliver training to analysts to upskill.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Perform front line accurate and precise real\-time monitoring and analysis correlation of logs/alerts from a multitude of security devices with a focus on the determination of what was said as events constitute security incidents.
* Collaborate to detect and respond to information security incidents, develop, maintain, and follow procedures for security event alerting, and participate in security investigations.
* The CTF Junior Security Analyst must be competent to work at a technical level, be capable of identifying threats and vectors that cause security events and be able to follow defined procedures for mitigating said threats.


 Essential Functions of the Job :
   

  

* Respond to network and host based security events
* Participate in detecting, investigating, and resolving security events
* Identify and propose areas for improvement within the Cyber Defense Response Center
* Provide documentation and project support
* Serve as an escalation point for difficult problems and complex inquiries
* Server as shift lead when necessary
* Conduct detailed security event analysis from network traffic attributes and host\-based attributes ( binary analysis, etc) to identify information security incidents
* Provide feedback on security control capability gaps based off of security intrusion trends
* Develop and maintain analytical procedures to improve security incident identification efficiency
* Demonstrate ability to drive process improvements and identify gaps


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Information Security Principles, Technologies, and Practices
* Experience with multiple security event detection platforms
* Fair understanding of Linux, TCP/IP, Network Security, encryption standards etc
* Aware of Types of attacks (DOS, DDOS etc)
* Understand basic IDS / IPS rules to identify and/or prevent malicious activity
* Aware of security log analysis.
* Idea about various penetration testing and application testing methodology and tools is a definite plus.
* Comfortable navigating and troubleshooting Linux and Windows system issues


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* Capability of working independently
* Soft Skills \- Excellent communication skills; written and verbal.
* Good Presentation skills
* Good Investigative, analytical and problem solving skills
* Ability to work in a team, with little supervision and using own initiative


**Experience:**
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience in one or more of the following:
* Working in a Security Monitoring/Security Operations Center environment (SOC)
* Experience investigating security events, threats and/or vulnerabilities
* Understanding of electronic investigation and log correlation Proficiency with the latest intrusion detection platforms; working knowledge of Linux and/or Windows systems administration (Including AD).
* Scripting or programming (Shell scripting, Power Shell, C, C\#, Java, etc)


**Qualifications, certifications and Education requirements:**
* Under Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science or Engineering or related domain (MCA/MTech/BTech/BCA /BSc CS or BSc IT).


**Desired Certifications:**
* Any Cyber Security Certification


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good demeanour.
* Willingness to work a flexible shifts with schedules that includes nights, weekends and holidays; shifts can changed based on business needs.
* Demonstrated integrity in a professional environment
* Willingness to learn new technologies.


**What We Look For**
 Under limited supervision the CTF (Cyber Triage and Forensics) Junior Security Analyst will report to the CTF Manager. The CTF Junior Security Analyst will perform tasks including monitoring, research, classification and analysis of security events that occur on the network or endpoint. The CTF Junior Security Analyst should have familiarity with the principles of network and endpoint security, current threat and attack trends, a basic understanding of the OSI model, and have a working knowledge of Defense in depth strategies.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Security Engineer
description:
* **24x7 Monitoring Systems and Networks:** 
  SOC Analysts continuously monitor networks and systems for suspicious activities or anomalies that could indicate a security breach. This involves analyzing logs, alerts, and other data to identify potential threats.
* **Incident Detection:** 
  Upon identifying a threat, SOC Analysts must quickly evaluate its severity. They use various tools, such as Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems, to correlate and analyze security data.
* **Investigation and Analysis:** 
  When a potential security incident is detected, SOC Analysts are responsible for conducting thorough investigations. They analyze the incident’s details, such as the attack vector, targeted systems, and possible impact, to determine the necessary response.
* **Incident Response:** 
  SOC Analysts are not just observers; they actively participate in incident response efforts. This includes containing and remediating security incidents to minimize damage and restore normal operations.
* Threat Analysis, Threat Intelligence
* Knowledge on Threat Hunting will be added advanctage



**Importance of SOC Analysts** 




 The significance of SOC Analysts extends beyond their daily responsibilities. They are essential for creating a security\-conscious culture within organizations. By establishing protocols and best practices, SOC Analysts help prevent potential attacks. Their proactive approach is crucial in safeguarding sensitive data and maintaining the integrity of IT systems.
 


* **Vulnerability Assessment (VA):** 
	+ Conduct regular vulnerability assessments to identify security weaknesses in applications and systems.
	+ Analyze and prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk and impact.
	+ Collaborate with development and operations teams to remediate identified vulnerabilities.
* **Penetration Testing (PT):** 
	+ Perform penetration testing on applications, networks, and systems to identify security gaps.
	+ Develop and execute test plans, document findings, and provide actionable recommendations.

title: Data Privacy Trainee
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Associate Consultant / Trainee will support the delivery of Data Privacy, Data Protection, Cyber Law, Cybersecurity and GRC engagements. This role is suitable for freshers and candidates with 0 – 2 years of experience who have an academic or professional background in Law, Cyber Law, Cybersecurity or Information Security. The candidate will work with experienced consultants to support privacy assessments, regulatory research, risk assessments, documentation and compliance activities. Knowledge of Cyber Law and Cybersecurity will be an added advantage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support Data Privacy and Data Protection assessments, including Privacy Gap Assessments, against applicable laws and regulations.
* Assist with PIA, DPIA, RoPA and Data Flow Mapping activities.
* Support review of privacy policies, procedures, privacy notices, consent, data retention and data subject rights.
* Research applicable regulations including DPDP Act, GDPR, PDPA and other relevant requirements.
* Support the team in understanding Cyber Law, Cybersecurity and Information Security requirements and emerging cyber risks.
* Assist in mapping legal and regulatory requirements to applicable privacy and cybersecurity controls.
* Support review of basic cybersecurity controls relating to access management, data security, encryption, vulnerability and incident management.
* Support privacy and compliance assessments, including collection and review of client information, documents and audit evidence.
* Support consultants in client engagements, meetings and information\-gathering sessions.
* Assist in preparing assessment reports, compliance checklists, trackers, presentations and other supporting documentation.


**Qualifications**
* Integrated B.Tech \+ LLB, Bachelor’s degree in Law, Cyber Law, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, IT or a related field.
* Candidates with a combination of Law and Cybersecurity / Information Security background will be an advantage.
* Relevant internships, academic projects or training in Data Privacy, Cyber Law, Cybersecurity, IT GRC or Compliance will be preferred.


**Work Experience**
* Freshers and candidates with 0–2 years of experience in Data Privacy, Cybersecurity, Cyber Law, IT GRC, IT Audit, Risk or Compliance.
* Good understanding of data privacy principles and regulatory requirements.
* Ability to read and understand laws, regulations and regulatory guidelines.
* Basic understanding of Cyber Law, Cybersecurity and Information Security concepts.
* Understanding of the relationship between legal requirements, privacy obligations and cybersecurity controls.
* Good research, analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to prepare clear documentation and reports.
* Willingness to learn and develop expertise in Data Privacy, Cybersecurity and GRC.
* Cyber Law and Cybersecurity knowledge will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to DPDP Act, GDPR, PCI DSS, ISO 27001 or ISO 27701 will be preferred.
* Attention to detail and ability to work with documentation and assessment evidence.
* Ability to manage assigned tasks and complete deliverables within timelines.
* Industry Certification will be an be plus: DCPP, CIPP, AIGP, ISO 27001, Security\+, CEH, CCNA or other relevant certifications will be an advantage.
* Tools Exposure: Exposure to Data Privacy or GRC tools such as OneTrust, BigID, TrustArc or similar platforms will be an advantage.

description:

**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a highly motivated
 **GNSS Authentication \& Security Engineer** 
 to join our team at
 **VyomIC** 
 , where we are building the next\-generation
 **global LEO\-PNT satellite constellation** 
 from India.
 



 In this role, you will design, analyze, simulate, and validate
 **authentication and encryption mechanisms for LEO\-PNT signals and navigation services** 
 , with a focus on protecting PNT data against spoofing, unauthorized access, and signal manipulation. You will work at the intersection of
 **GNSS security, cryptographic techniques, signal design, receiver algorithms, and system\-level performance validation** 
 , contributing to the development of secure and resilient PNT services for VyomIC’s constellation.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Study existing GNSS authentication and encryption techniques, including
 **OSNMA, TESLA\-based schemes, digital signatures, MACs, and encrypted spreading/signals** 
 .
* Define the
 **security requirements and threat model** 
 for VyomIC's LEO\-PNT signals, focusing on spoofing, navigation\-message forgery, replay, and unauthorized access.
* Evaluate and recommend suitable
 **authentication architecture** 
 for the LEO\-PNT navigation message.
* Design how authentication data, keys, signatures/MACs, and associated metadata can be incorporated into the
 **navigation message structure** 
 with minimal impact on data rate and TTFF.
* Develop
 **MATLAB/Python simulations** 
 for authentication generation, transmission, verification, latency, overhead, and failure cases.
* Analyze security\-performance trade\-offs including
 **message overhead, computational complexity, authentication latency, false acceptance/rejection, and receiver resource requirements** 
 .



**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, ECE, EE, Communications, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
* Strong fundamentals in cryptography, authentication, secure communications, and cybersecurity.
* Knowledge of MACs, digital signatures, hashing, encryption, key management, and broadcast authentication schemes.
* Good Python/C/C\+\+ programming skills; MATLAB experience is a plus.
* Understanding of GNSS/PNT systems and navigation signals is an advantage.
* Prior experience with GNSS signal authentication, secure navigation, or GNSS receiver systems is a strong plus.



**Why Join Us** 



* **Build the future of global navigation** 
 \- Be the part of the
 **revolution** 
 , work on a mission that redefines how the world connects, navigates, and operates in the new age.
* **Be part of the founding journey** 
 \- shape the architecture of a global satellite constellation from the ground up and work directly with the Founding Team at VyomIC.
* **Collaborate with High Profile advisors** 
 \- learn from and engage with senior experts who bring decades of experience.
* **High\-impact, high\-ownership role** 
 \- your work directly influences real\-world systems that demand precision, security, and scale.
* **Work alongside a world\-class team** 
 \- collaborate with experts across astrodynamics, signal processing, embedded systems, mission operations, ETC.
* **Grow with the mission \-** 
 as the constellation scales, so do your opportunities for leadership, innovation, and long\-term career growth.

title: Security Engineer, Code Review and Vulnerability Research (Remote Contract)
description:
Part\-time, remote, paid per completed task. A project we are staffing needs engineers who are as comfortable breaking software as building it: people who can open an unfamiliar repository, find what is insecure or broken, fix it properly, and write up why.
 



  





  





 Typical week
 



  





 Roughly fifteen hours, scheduled around whatever else you do. The tasks are self\-contained pieces of security\-flavoured engineering work whose results feed into the training of AI coding assistants.
 



  





  





 What you would actually be doing
 



  





 \- Hunting down and fixing defects, including exploitable ones, in codebases you did not write
 



  





 \- Auditing code for weaknesses, running pen\-test style checks, and rating severity
 



  





 \- Shipping small features and refactors in one of: Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C\+\+
 



  





 \- Tuning backend code for performance and hardening it against abuse
 



  





 \- Writing short, clear write\-ups of what you found and what you changed
 



  





  





 The bar
 



  





 \- Genuine hands\-on security experience (audits, vulnerability assessment, pen testing)
 



  





 \- Solid general software\-engineering skills, backend included; you can refactor legacy code without breaking it
 



  





 \- You know how secure development lifecycles work and what current attacks look like
 



  





 \- You explain technical findings crisply, in English
 



  





  





 No previous involvement with AI projects is needed.
 



  





  





 Money and terms
 



  





 Contractor engagement, output\-based. The published range for this project runs up to about $100 an hour depending on task type; exact terms are confirmed at onboarding.
 



  





  





 Apply via OpenTrain, where independent AI\-evaluation and technical contractors manage their profile and projects in one place.

title: Sr. Security Researcher
description:
**A BIT ABOUT US** 




 Appknox is one of the top Mobile Application security companies recognized by Gartner and G2\. A profitable B2B SaaS startup headquartered in Singapore \& working from Bengaluru.
 



 The primary goal of Appknox is to help businesses and mobile developers secure their mobile applications with a focus on delivery speed and high\-quality security audits.
 



 Appknox has helped secure mobile apps at Fortune 500 companies with major brands spread across regions like India, South\-East Asia, Middle\-East, US, and expanding rapidly. We have secured 300\+ Enterprises globally.
 



 We are a 65\+ incredibly passionate team working to make an impact and helping some of the biggest companies globally. We work in a highly collaborative, very fast\-paced work environment. If you have what it takes to be part of the team, we are excited and let’s speak further.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 To join the security team engaging with multiple clients, helping them with end to end security audits, also research about new topics and vulnerabilities to be added to the scanner, present it in conferences.
 



  





**What An Ideal Candidate Would Look Like:** 



* Skills \- Application Penetration Testing (Web, iOS and Android), experience with IoT testing, source code audits.
* Technology Stack: AWS, GCP, Objective C, Java, Python
* Responsibilities: Engage with clients for scoping call, perform security audits, remediation call with clients to patch the issues, research on new technologies/vulnerabilities



  





**Minimum Requirements** 



* 2\-4\+ years of experience in application security and vulnerability research
* Strong foundation in mobile app security \- Android or Ios
* Proven track record of discovering and disclosing CVEs in mobile platforms or popular applications (provide \- github/bug bounty profiles)
* Strong understanding of exploit mitigations and proven ability to bypass them
* Should be able to architect automated detection logic for new vulnerabilities and integrate them into our security products
* Develop AI\-driven agents to automate dynamic analysis
* Should be able to Leverage AI/LLMs to augment Pentesting efforts
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment, balancing deep research with practical deliverables



  





**Good to have Requirements** 



* Understanding of AI/ML security risks



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Security assessment of web/mobile applications on various platforms
* Focusing on Mobile Application Security Research for new vulnerabilities
* Static and Dynamic Code Analysis
* Develop and interpret security standards and guides
* Automation of exploit development
* Understand and explain the results with impact on business and compliance status
* Continuously learning and training on latest tools and technique



  





**Work Expectations** 





 Within 1 month
 




 Training on processes, security workflows and develop understanding on internal tools.
 



  






 Within 3 months
 




 Actively contributing in exploit development and automation of it with the team.
 



  






 Within 6 months
 




 Expected to achieve Subject Matter Expert status on our core security products. We expect you to validate your findings against real\-world conditions, with a strong emphasis on translating internal discoveries into actionable bug bounty submissions and earned CVEs to benchmark your impact against the external security community.
 



  






 Within 1 Year
 




 By the end of your first year, you will be expected to produce and submit a piece of novel, peer\-reviewed security research. This deliverable must be of a quality suitable for top\-tier industry conferences.
 



  





**Personality traits we really admire** 



* A confident and dynamic working persona, which can bring fun to the team, and a sense of humour, is an added advantage.
* Great attitude to ask questions, learn and suggest process improvements.
* Has attention to details and helps identify edge cases.
* Highly motivated and coming up with fresh ideas and perspectives to help us move towards our goals faster.
* Follow timelines and absolute commitment to deadlines.



  





**Interview Process \- would be team specific** 



* Round 1\- CTF round
* Round 2 \-Profile Evaluation; HR
* Round 3 \-Technical Interview with security team members
* Round 4 \-Technical Interview with the Hiring Manager
* Round 5 \-Technical round with CTO
* Round 6 \-HR Round



  





**Compensation** 



* As per Industry Standards



  





**Why Join Us** 



* **Freedom \& Responsibility:** 
 If you are a person who enjoys challenging work \& pushing your boundaries, then this is the right place for you. We appreciate new ideas \& ownership as well as flexibility with working hours.
* **Great Salary \& Equity:** 
 We keep up with the market standards \& provide pay packages considering updated standards. Also as Appknox continues to grow, you’ll have a great opportunity to earn more \& grow with us. Moreover, we also provide equity options for our top performers.
* **Holistic Growth:** 
 We foster a culture of continuous learning and take a much more holistic approach to train and develop our assets: the employees. We shall also support you all on that journey of yours.
* **Transparency:** 
 Being a part of a start\-up is an amazing experience, one of the reasons being open communication \& transparency at multiple levels. Working with Appknox will give you the opportunity to experience it all first\-hand.

title: System Administrator
description:
**Summary:** 




 This role is the primary point of contact for IT support within the organization, helping employees resolve laptop issues, account access problems, software installations, and everyday technical queries. It is an ideal opportunity to build a strong IT foundation while being guided and mentored by an experienced senior team.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




 The “System Administrator” is responsible for maintaining smooth day\-to\-day IT operations across the organization. This role covers end\-user support, asset management, system upkeep, and vendor coordination, making it a well\-rounded position for someone looking to grow within an IT support function.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Provide day\-to\-day support to employees on tickets, laptops, logins, printers, software installations, and related requests.
* Complete daily preventive checks across the office — verifying that IT hardware, servers, UPS, and internet links are up, both physically and logically — and act on any deviation.
* Build and deliver new laptops end to end: imaging, domain join, host ID and AD account creation, project\-specific software, endpoint agent installation, asset tagging, and user handover.
* Maintain the asset register and host ID records accurately, and provision test PCs and virtual machines against validated user requirements, tracking usage duration and reclaiming resources on expiry.
* Manage the user account lifecycle — email IDs, AD accounts, distribution lists and group memberships, password resets, and access provisioning and revocation during onboarding and exit.
* Test and deploy Windows and third\-party patches through the endpoint management console, monitor patch non\-compliance reports, and resolve the root cause of failures.
* Maintain endpoint security compliance: monitor antivirus and endpoint protection consoles, bring non\-compliant systems back into compliance, respond to threat and data\-loss\-prevention alerts, and validate license terms for software approval requests.
* Run scheduled backups of servers, Active Directory, and databases to the NAS, and perform periodic restore checks with project teams to confirm data integrity.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware, software, and facility requirements — obtaining and comparing quotes, securing approvals, releasing purchase orders, and following up until delivery and installation.
* Support network and infrastructure monitoring, including Wi\-Fi and LAN authentication, firewall and CCTV checks, and report anomalies to the senior team.
* Keep trackers, checklists, and basic documentation current to support ISO audits, knowledge sharing, and team organisation.
* Escalate recurring or complex issues to the Team Lead or Senior System Administrator for permanent resolution.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Diploma, BCA, B.Sc., or B.E. (Postgraduate candidates will not be considered.)
* Proficient with Windows, Outlook, and standard office productivity software.
* Basic understanding of networks, Wi\-Fi, and general office IT infrastructure.
* Some familiarity with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.
* 1–5 years of hands\-on IT support or system administration experience.

title: Software Engineer, Products & Solutions
description:
ABV \| Bengaluru \| Full\-time, in person
   

  

 About ABV
   

  

 ABV works across investing, business building and technology\-led execution. We strengthen products, modernise systems and improve operations to drive growth.
   

  

 Our work spans commercial opportunities and government and enterprise needs, combining research, operational improvement and hands\-on implementation. This scope also includes improving and scaling technology businesses following acquisition: strengthening products, integrating systems and building the operational foundations for growth.
   

  

 About the role
   

  

 We’re hiring a Software Engineer, Products \& Solutions to build and deliver the technology behind these initiatives.
   

  

 You’ll translate business requirements into working software, make practical technical decisions and take clearly scoped projects or components through development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvement. The role combines product thinking with hands\-on engineering and responsibility for delivery.
   

  

 The scope includes enterprise applications, AI\-assisted workspaces, automation and software supporting public\-sector and utility operations. Some projects will involve building new products; others will require integrating systems and delivering against client requirements.
   

  

 We believe the right engineers, equipped with strong AI fluency and sound judgment, can become 10x builders. We’re looking for people who turn that potential into working software: using AI to learn unfamiliar systems, test ideas, automate repetitive work and ship faster without compromising quality. You don’t need years of experience to demonstrate this, but you do need to show what you have built. AI will be central to how you work, even when the product itself is not an AI application.
   

  

 Responsibilities
   

  

 • Turn business and user requirements into implementation plans, technical choices and clear delivery milestones.
   

 • Build applications, interfaces, backend services, databases, APIs and integrations.
   

 • Write maintainable code, use version control and document important design decisions.
   

 • Choose and combine AI coding tools, models and agents to research, implement, test and debug software. Review their output and take responsibility for the result.
   

 • Write automated tests, investigate failures and check edge cases before release.
   

 • Deploy and monitor software, troubleshoot production issues and improve reliability, performance and running costs.
   

 • Work with clients, users, vendors and domain specialists to clarify requirements, resolve blockers and support acceptance testing.
   

 • Build security, appropriate access controls, data validation and auditability into the systems you deliver.
   

 • Contribute to post\-acquisition improvement projects by modernising software, integrating systems and automating workflows to support business growth.
   

 • Communicate progress, risks and technical trade\-offs clearly.
   

  

 Minimum qualifications
   

  

 • Ability to write and debug code in at least one general\-purpose programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Go or C\+\+.
   

 • Understanding of core programming concepts, common data structures and basic algorithmic efficiency.
   

 • Practical experience building a software project using APIs, persistent data storage or a user interface.
   

 • Familiarity with Git and the fundamentals of testing and debugging.
   

 • Ability to break an unfamiliar problem into manageable steps and explain your implementation choices.
   

 • Evidence of work you can demonstrate and discuss, whether from employment, internships, coursework, independent projects or open\-source contributions.
   

  

 Recent graduates and early\-career engineers are welcome. A computer science or related degree is useful, but equivalent practical experience is welcome. You do not need prior experience in every area of the role.
   

  

 Preferred experience
   

  

 • Building web or desktop applications with responsive, accessible interfaces.
   

 • Working with relational databases, data modelling and third\-party integrations.
   

 • Deploying applications to cloud environments and using automated build, test or deployment workflows.
   

 • Working with LLM APIs, tool calling, agent workflows and evaluations.
   

 • Handling background tasks, streaming updates, session state and error recovery.
   

 • Managing permissions, credentials and sensitive data securely.
   

 • Building billing, payment reconciliation or operational software.
   

  

 Familiarity with electricity utilities, public\-sector systems or other regulated environments is a plus, not a requirement.
   

  

 How you work
   

  

 You care about whether software solves the user’s problem, not just whether the code runs.
   

  

 We value high agency: taking initiative, proposing next steps, raising blockers early and seeing work through. You should be comfortable using AI extensively while retaining the judgment to question its output, verify results and recognise when specialist input is needed.
   

  

 Ownership and growth
   

  

 You’ll take responsibility for clearly defined deliverables, with room to own larger projects as you demonstrate sound judgment and reliable execution. The scope of responsibility will reflect your experience and the requirements of each project.
   

  

 To apply
   

  

 Apply through ABV’s careers page: https://abvfirm.com/careers/software\-engineer
   

  

 Applications are reviewed through ABV’s careers page. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted with the next steps.

 You will take use cases from requirement discovery and solution design through prototyping, implementation, testing and production rollout. The ideal candidate is curious about how AI systems behave, enjoys experimenting with prompts and is comfortable solving problems in a fast\-moving startup environment.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 AI Agent and Prompt Development
 


* Design, write and optimize prompts for AI agents, voice agents and chatbots.
* Convert business requirements into structured conversational flows, agent instructions, decision logic and guardrails.
* Build and configure AI agents capable of performing tasks, using tools, calling APIs and managing multi\-step conversations.

* Analyse agent failures, hallucinations and inconsistent responses, and continuously improve performance.

 Program Execution
 


* Own AI implementation programs from discovery and POC to deployment and production go\-live.

* Conduct client discussions to understand business processes and recommend suitable AI\-led workflows.
* Translate client requirements into clear product configurations, user stories and implementation documents.
* Coordinate API integrations, data requirements, UAT, issue resolution and production readiness.
* Track deliverables closely and proactively address delays, blockers and execution risks.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.
* Take ownership of issues until they are completely resolved.



 Voice AI and Conversational Experience
 


* Design natural and outcome\-oriented conversations for voice and chat channels.
* Configure conversation flows for use cases such as customer service, sales, collections, lead qualification and customer onboarding.
* Work with concepts such as intent recognition, entity extraction, context retention, interruption handling, fallback responses and human\-agent handoffs.
* Collaborate with technical teams on integrations involving LLMs, APIs, ASR, TTS, telephony and enterprise systems.
* Review conversation transcripts and performance data to identify opportunities for improvement.



 Must\-Have Requirements
 


* 1–3 years of experience in AI implementation, program management, product operations, solutions, conversational AI or a related role.
* Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering and Generative AI tools.
* Demonstrable experience building or configuring at least one AI agent, voice agent, chatbot or LLM\-powered workflow.
* Understanding of LLM concepts such as system prompts, few\-shot prompting, structured outputs, tool or function calling, context management and hallucination control.
* Ability to independently test, troubleshoot and improve AI\-generated responses.
* Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, webhooks and system integrations.
* Strong execution discipline with the ability to drive projects from idea to production.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work from our Mumbai office.



 Good\-to\-Have Skills
 


* Experience with agent\-building or workflow platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Voiceflow, Dialogflow, Retell AI, Vapi or similar tools.
* Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or open\-source LLM APIs.
* Exposure to RAG, vector databases, knowledge bases and multi\-agent workflows.
* Experience with voice technologies, including speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech or telephony integrations.
* Exposure to enterprise SaaS, BFSI, fintech or customer\-service automation.
* Basic proficiency in Python, SQL or low\-code automation platforms.
* Experience working directly with enterprise clients.



 What Success Looks Like
 



 Within the first few months, you should be able to:
 


* Independently convert a business use case into a working AI\-agent workflow.
* Create prompts, conversation logic, guardrails and comprehensive test scenarios.
* Manage a client implementation from requirements gathering to go\-live.
* Identify agent\-performance issues and improve outcomes through structured experimentation.
* Deliver multiple AI programs with speed, ownership and attention to detail.



 Who Will Thrive in This Role
 



 You will be a strong fit if you:
 


* Prefer building and executing over only creating plans and trackers.
* Experiment with AI tools beyond your formal responsibilities.
* Are comfortable working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving technology.
* Combine structured program management with hands\-on problem\-solving.
* Take ownership without waiting for detailed instructions.
* Are excited by the opportunity to build production\-grade AI agents for large enterprises.

title: Research Robotics
description:
We are hiring for a Research Robotics Engineer role with a fast\-growing AI company building the intelligence layer for physical\-world AI. The company is working at the intersection of robotics perception, embodied AI, egocentric video understanding, and voice\-driven interaction to develop AI systems that can perceive, reason, and act in real\-world environments.
 



  





 💡 Why Join?
 



 Work on challenging robotics and AI problems involving 3D perception, computer vision, multimodal learning, sensor data, and embodied intelligence. You'll collaborate with a strong research and engineering team to develop systems that operate in complex, real\-world environments, work on cutting\-edge research, and contribute directly to building the next generation of intelligent physical\-world systems.
 



  





 Roles and Responsibilities:
 


* **2\+ years on problems in this space.**
* **Publications in egocentric vision, 3D hand pose, VLA / VLM models, or robot learning.**
* **MS / PhD in computer vision, robotics or ML — or equivalent published research output.**
* Egocentric pose that survives the camera. We have narrowed the suspects (rectification residual, FOV, shutter type) and currently route between several public SLAM / VIO systems per clip.
* Metric 3D hand pose. Build the in\-house hand model that is stable in the world frame, and decide the representation (MANO topology, 6D vs axis\-angle) rather than inheriting it.
* Deep hands\-on work in at least two of: 3D hand / human pose reconstruction, stereo or monocular depth, VIO / SLAM, open\-vocabulary detection and segmentation, video VLMs.
* You have trained a perception model that beat an off\-the\-shelf baseline on a real domain and shipped it. Data curation, loss design and eval decisions were yours.
* Multi\-view geometry is fluent, not looked up: rectification, epipolar residual, Q matrix and depth sign conventions, triangulation, world vs camera frame.
* You can read a calibration report and say whether the problem is the camera or the model — and be right.
* Strong Python and PyTorch; you own training and inference code, not notebooks.
* Production inference experience on AWS: containerization, batch pipelines, orchestration.



  





  





**Location: Bangalore Onsite**

title: Telesales Executive
description:
**Telesales Executive**

**Department:** Sales \& Business Development  
**Reports to:** Sales Manager  
**Location:** Raipur \| **Full\-Time**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Telesales Executive** who will be responsible for connecting with prospective customers over calls, understanding their requirements, explaining relevant products/services, and converting qualified leads into sales. The role involves regular follow\-ups, handling objections, maintaining accurate CRM records, and achieving assigned sales targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Contact, qualify, and convert **inbound and outbound leads** through calls and follow\-ups.
* Understand customer requirements and provide appropriate **product/service information and demonstrations**.
* Handle customer queries, objections, and concerns effectively to drive conversions.
* Follow up with prospects consistently and close sales within the defined **3–7 day conversion cycle**, wherever applicable.
* Maintain **100% CRM updates**, accurate customer information, call records, and follow\-up status.
* Support **campaigns, webinars, referral activities, and other outreach initiatives**.
* Coordinate with the relevant team for payment, documentation, onboarding, or other post\-sale requirements.
* Share daily activity reports and participate in regular performance review meetings.
* Continuously improve **call quality, follow\-up effectiveness, and conversion metrics**.

**KPIs**

* **CRM compliance \>95%** and timely updating of all lead activities.
* Fresh leads contacted within the defined **TAT**.
* Achievement of assigned **daily/weekly/monthly sales targets**.
* Maintain targeted **call\-to\-conversion and lead\-to\-sale conversion ratios**.
* Maintain required call activity, follow\-up, and customer engagement levels.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* **Bachelor’s degree** in any discipline; Master’s degree is a plus.
* **0–2 years** of experience in telesales, inside sales, telecalling, customer counselling, or business development preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication and a sales\-oriented mindset may also be considered.

**Skills**

* Excellent **verbal communication and interpersonal skills**.
* Strong **sales, persuasion, counselling, and objection\-handling skills**.
* Comfortable making **inbound and outbound calls**.
* Basic knowledge of **CRM and MS Excel**.
* Target\-oriented with strong follow\-up and time\-management skills.
* Positive attitude, self\-motivated, and a good team player.

**Perks**

* **Incentives/commission** linked to performance.
* Structured **sales and product training**.
* Opportunity for **career growth within the sales function**.

Benefits:

* Health insurance

* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

description:
**Job Description: Customer Relationship Manager (CRM)**

**Company:** Gayatri Industries

**Location:** Silvassa, Dadra \& Nagar Haveli

**Department:** Sales \& Customer Relations

**Reports To:** Business Development Head / Management

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**About Gayatri Industries**

Gayatri Industries is a precision fabrication and modular construction company established in 1987, based in Silvassa, Dadra \& Nagar Haveli. ISO 9001:2015 certified, we specialize in manufacturing portable cabins, Pre\-Engineered Buildings (PEB), and related fabricated products for clients across industrial, infrastructure, and energy sectors.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive and personable **Customer Relationship Manager** to build, manage, and strengthen relationships with our clients across the order lifecycle — from initial inquiry through delivery and after\-sales support. The ideal candidate will act as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring high satisfaction, repeat business, and smooth coordination between clients and internal teams (sales, production, and dispatch).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the main point of contact for existing and prospective clients, addressing queries, concerns, and requirements promptly and professionally.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with key accounts to encourage repeat orders and referrals.
* Coordinate with the sales and business development team to follow up on leads, quotations, and order confirmations.
* Coordinate with the production and dispatch teams to track order status and proactively update customers on timelines.
* Handle post\-delivery follow\-ups, resolve complaints, and ensure timely closure of service issues.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date customer records, interaction history, and order details (in CRM software / Excel trackers as applicable).
* Gather customer feedback and share insights with management to improve products, processes, and service quality.
* Support the creation of customer satisfaction reports and periodic account reviews.
* Identify upselling/cross\-selling opportunities within the existing client base.
* Assist in preparing proposals, follow\-up emails, and client\-facing documentation as needed.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field (MBA preferred).
* Fresher or 1–2 years of experience in customer relationship management, client servicing, or a similar client\-facing role (experience in manufacturing, construction, or B2B industries preferred).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi (Gujarati is a plus).
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and relation with clients.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word); familiarity with CRM software is an advantage.
* Good organizational skills with the ability to multitask and manage multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Problem\-solving mindset with a customer\-first attitude.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in the fabrication, PEB, portable cabin, or construction industry.
* Familiarity with basic order/production workflows in a manufacturing setup.

**Key Attributes**

* Professional demeanor and strong ownership mindset.
* Patience and empathy when handling client concerns.
* Comfortable working cross\-functionally with sales, production, and dispatch teams.
* Willingness to travel occasionally for client meetings/site visits, if required.

**Compensation**

As per industry standards, commensurate with experience.

title: Tea Barista Executive
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – TEA BARISTA**

**Position: Tea Barista**

**Department: Tea Room / F\&B Operations**

**Job Purpose**

The Tea Barista is responsible for preparing and serving high\-quality tea and other beverages while ensuring excellent guest service, proper tea presentation, hygiene, and smooth day\-to\-day beverage counter operations.

The role requires good knowledge of tea varieties, brewing methods, serving standards, and the ability to create a premium and welcoming tea experience for guests.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Tea \& Beverage Preparation**

\- Prepare and serve different varieties of tea as per company recipes and SOPs.

\- Understand appropriate brewing time, temperature, quantity, and serving method for different teas.

\- Prepare hot and cold tea beverages, iced teas, specialty teas, and other approved beverages.

\- Ensure consistency in taste, quality, temperature, quantity, and presentation.

\- Prepare beverages according to approved recipes and presentation standards.

\- Handle tea leaves, herbs, milk, syrups, garnishes, and other ingredients carefully.

**2\. Guest Service**

\- Welcome guests politely and professionally.

\- Take beverage orders accurately and ensure timely service.

\- Explain tea varieties, flavours, brewing methods, and serving options to guests when required.

\- Recommend suitable teas based on guest preferences.

\- Maintain a warm, courteous, and premium service experience.

\- Handle basic guest queries and escalate complaints to the concerned senior.

**3\. Tea Knowledge**

\- Develop good knowledge of the company's tea collection and menu.

\- Learn about different tea categories, origins, flavour profiles, brewing methods, and serving styles.

\- Stay updated on new tea beverages and company product offerings.

\- Be able to explain the basic characteristics of teas to guests.

**4\. Counter \& Equipment Management**

\- Set up the tea/beverage counter before service.

\- Maintain cleanliness and proper arrangement of the tea bar.

\- Clean and maintain kettles, brewers, infusers, cups, glasses, utensils, and other equipment.

\- Ensure all equipment is used safely and correctly.

\- Complete opening and closing duties as assigned.

**5\. Hygiene \& Food Safety**

\- Maintain excellent personal grooming and hygiene.

\- Follow all company hygiene, sanitation, and food\-safety standards.

\- Keep the beverage counter, equipment, storage area, and service area clean at all times.

\- Ensure proper storage and handling of ingredients.

\- Follow FIFO and expiry\-control practices.

\- Immediately report damaged, expired, or contaminated ingredients.

**6\. Stock \& Inventory**

\- Monitor tea, milk, sugar, herbs, syrups, garnishes, disposables, and other beverage supplies.

\- Inform the supervisor about low\-stock items in advance.

\- Assist with daily stock checking and inventory counting.

\- Maintain proper portion control and minimize beverage wastage.

\- Ensure ingredients are properly stored after use.

**7\. POS \& Billing**

\- Take orders through the POS system where applicable.

\- Handle cash/card/digital payments accurately if assigned.

\- Ensure orders are entered correctly and communicated to the service team.

\- Maintain proper billing discipline.

**8\. Team Coordination**

\- Coordinate with the service, kitchen, housekeeping, and management teams.

\- Support colleagues during peak hours and special events.

\- Follow instructions from the reporting manager.

\- Maintain discipline, punctuality, teamwork, and professional conduct.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

\- Good knowledge or interest in tea and beverage preparation.

\- Strong customer\-service and communication skills.

\- Good presentation and attention to detail.

\- Ability to follow recipes and SOPs accurately.

\- Good hygiene and grooming standards.

\- Ability to work under pressure during busy hours.

\- Team player with a positive and disciplined attitude.

\- Basic POS/cash\-handling knowledge is an advantage.

\- Willingness to learn about premium and specialty teas.

**Qualification \& Experience**

\- Minimum 10\+2 preferred.

\- Diploma/certificate in Hospitality, F\&B, or Barista training will be an advantage.

\- 6 months–2 years of experience in a café, tea room, restaurant, hotel, or beverage outlet preferred.

\- Freshers with good communication skills and a genuine interest in tea may also be considered.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

\- Tea and beverage quality \& consistency.

\- Guest satisfaction and service quality.

\- Order accuracy and service speed.

\- Compliance with recipes and SOPs.

\- Hygiene and grooming standards.

\- Proper equipment handling.

\- Stock management and wastage control.

\- Punctuality, discipline, and teamwork.

**Work Requirements**

\- Full\-time, on\-site position.

\- Flexible working hours/shifts as per Tea Room operations.

\- Willingness to work weekends and holidays as per roster.

\- Ability to stand and work at the beverage counter for extended periods.

company policy.

2

\* Minimum 1–3 years of relevant experience in Business Development, Sales, B2B Sales, Merchant Acquisition,

Field Sales, or Client Relationship Management.

\* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

\* Proven ability to generate and convert leads independently.

\* Strong negotiation, persuasion, and closing abilities.

\* Experience in achieving sales targets.

\* Good knowledge of local markets and business networks.

\* Proficiency in WhatsApp, CRM, Google Sheets, and basic reporting tools.

\* Product Value: ₹9,999 \+ GST

\* Installation Location: Billing counter, entrance, waiting area, or another high\-visibility location.

\* Installation and panel quality are managed by the company.

Employees must communicate only company\-approved product details and commercial terms.

Merchant Payment Terms

\* Total Product Value: ₹9,999 \+ GST.

\* 50% payment at the time of merchant profile/dashboard creation.

\* A 3\-month employment commitment/bond will apply.
