title: Product Manager
description:
At ARIS, we’re on a mission to make construction simple, reliable and scalable — combining deep domain expertise with cutting\-edge technology. This isn’t a marketplace or a layer on top of existing systems, we’re building the underlying technology that powers logistics, credit decisions, and compliance at scale.
 



  





 Our platform runs live operations across 900\+ pin codes and supports real\-time tracking, automated documentation, and financial decisioning across a large supply chain. Performance, reliability, and correctness matter here.
 



  





 We believe that technology and product are two sides of the same coin: precision in code and empathy for the end user.
 



  





**Role Description:** 




 We are seeking a skilled Product Manager to join our dynamic tech and product team. As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for leading the development and execution of our product roadmap. You will collaborate closely with cross functional teams to define product requirements, prioritize features, and ensure the timely delivery of high\-quality products. This role requires a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of technology and a proven track record of successfully managing products from ideation to launch.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




 As a Product Manager, you will:
 



  




* Develop and maintain the product roadmap aligned with business goals and customer needs.
* Gather and prioritize product requirements from stakeholders, customers, and market research.
* Work closely with engineering, design, marketing, and sales teams to deliver products that meet market demands.
* Define product vision, strategy, and go\-to\-market plans.
* Conduct competitive analysis and market research to inform product decisions.
* Monitor and analyze product performance metrics, and make data\-driven decisions.
* Drive product launches including working with marketing, executives, and other product management team members.
* Act as a product evangelist to build awareness and understanding internally and externally.
* Proactively identify and resolve issues that may impair the team's ability to meet strategic, financial, and technical goals.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 2 to 6 years of experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role, preferably in a tech\-driven environment.
* Proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to executive leadership.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, agile environment and manage multiple competing priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field (MBA preferred)

title: Technical Assistant
company: Amnaa Project Pvt Ltd; Benetton India Pvt Ltd
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Position: Technical Assistant to Managing Director – Mechanical Engineering**

**Industry:** Water \& Wastewater Treatment / EPC  
**Department:** MD Office / Technical \& Projects  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director (MD)  
**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering  
**Experience:** 5\-8 years preferred; exceptional freshers may be considered  
**Location:** New Delhi  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Job Purpose**

The Technical Assistant to the Managing Director will provide **technical, project, operational, and coordination support directly to the MD** across the company's water and wastewater treatment business.

The role requires a Mechanical Engineer who can understand technical matters, track projects and critical activities, coordinate with internal departments, consultants, vendors and clients, and provide the MD with **accurate and timely technical updates for decision\-making**.

The candidate will act as a link between the **MD's office and Engineering, Projects, Procurement, Production, Site, Operations, and Maintenance teams**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Technical Support to MD**

* Assist the MD in reviewing technical matters related to water and wastewater treatment projects.
* Study project drawings, BOQs, specifications, equipment datasheets, quotations, technical offers, and reports.
* Prepare concise technical summaries and presentations for the MD.
* Highlight critical technical issues, delays, risks, cost implications, and required management decisions.
* Assist the MD in evaluating technical proposals from vendors, consultants, contractors, and project teams.
* Conduct technical research on new equipment, technologies, products, and treatment solutions.
* Maintain a systematic record of important technical decisions and action points.

**2\. Project Monitoring \& Coordination**

* Monitor the progress of ongoing WTP, STP, ETP, RO and other water\-treatment projects.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Design Engineers, Procurement, and other departments to obtain project updates.
* Track project milestones, equipment deliveries, installation, erection, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Prepare **daily/weekly/monthly project status reports** for the MD.
* Identify delays and bottlenecks and bring them to the MD's attention with relevant facts and possible solutions.
* Follow up on action items assigned by the MD and ensure timely closure.
* Maintain a project\-wise **action tracker and management dashboard**.

**3\. Engineering \& Mechanical Responsibilities**

* Review mechanical aspects of water\-treatment projects under the direction of senior management.
* Understand and review:
* Pumps and pumping systems
* Piping systems
* Valves and fittings
* Pressure vessels
* Filters
* Agitators and mixers
* Blowers and compressors
* Dosing systems
* Clarifiers and sludge\-handling systems
* RO/UF equipment
* Mechanical equipment and packages
* Read and understand P\&IDs, GA drawings, equipment layouts, datasheets, BOQs, and mechanical specifications.
* Assist in identifying technical discrepancies between drawings, specifications, offers, and actual site conditions.
* Coordinate with engineering teams for technical clarifications and modifications.

**4\. Vendor \& Procurement Coordination**

* Assist the MD in reviewing major equipment and vendor proposals.
* Coordinate with vendors for technical offers, drawings, datasheets, inspection reports, delivery schedules, and pending documents.
* Assist in preparing technical comparison statements for equipment and machinery.
* Track critical procurement items and highlight delays.
* Coordinate with procurement and technical teams to ensure timely ordering and delivery of project\-critical equipment.
* Participate in vendor meetings when required and prepare meeting notes/action points.

**5\. Site \& Project Visits**

* Visit project sites with the MD or independently when required.
* Monitor mechanical installation, erection, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Interact with site teams, contractors, consultants, and clients on technical matters.
* Verify reported site issues and provide factual updates to the MD.
* Prepare site visit reports with photographs, observations, pending actions, and recommendations.
* Follow up on site\-related issues until closure.

**6\. Management Reporting \& MIS**

Prepare and maintain management reports covering:

* Project progress
* Engineering status
* Procurement status
* Equipment delivery
* Site execution
* Commissioning status
* Major technical issues
* Client/consultant issues
* Pending approvals
* Vendor performance
* Project risks and delays
* Action items assigned by MD

The candidate should be capable of converting detailed technical information into **short, clear management\-level updates**.

**7\. Coordination with Departments**

Act as a coordination point between the MD and:

* Design \& Engineering
* Project Execution
* Procurement
* Production/Fabrication
* Site Operations
* Commissioning
* Maintenance
* Quality
* Commercial/Contracts
* Sales/Business Development

Ensure that important instructions from the MD are communicated to the relevant teams and followed through to completion.

**8\. New Technology \& Business Support**

* Research emerging technologies in water and wastewater treatment.
* Study new mechanical equipment and treatment solutions available in the market.
* Assist the MD in evaluating potential technology partners and suppliers.
* Support preparation of technical presentations for clients and business meetings.
* Assist in technical due diligence for new projects and opportunities.
* Collect and analyze market/competitor technical information when required.

**Required Technical Knowledge**

The candidate should have a good understanding of:

* Water Treatment Plants (WTP)
* Sewage Treatment Plants (STP)
* Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP)
* Reverse Osmosis (RO)
* Ultrafiltration (UF)
* MEE/ZLD systems – basic understanding preferred
* Pumping systems
* Mechanical equipment
* Piping and valves
* Equipment selection and specifications
* Mechanical erection and commissioning
* Preventive maintenance
* P\&IDs and GA drawings
* BOQ/BOM and technical specifications

**Required Skills**

* Strong Mechanical Engineering fundamentals
* Excellent MS Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Good knowledge of MS Word and documentation
* Ability to read engineering drawings and P\&IDs
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong follow\-up and coordination ability
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Ability to prepare professional management reports
* Ability to work with senior management and cross\-functional teams
* Willingness to travel to project sites

**Personal Attributes**

The ideal candidate should be:

* **Highly organized and disciplined**
* Proactive rather than waiting for instructions
* Comfortable working directly with the MD
* Strong in follow\-up and execution
* Technically curious and willing to learn
* Good at handling confidential business information
* Capable of working under pressure and managing multiple priorities
* Detail\-oriented but able to understand the overall business objective
* Professional in dealing with clients, consultants, vendors, and employees

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Timely and accurate reporting to the MD.
* Effective tracking and closure of MD action points.
* Accuracy of project status information.
* Identification and escalation of project risks and delays.
* Effective coordination between departments.
* Timely follow\-up with vendors and project teams.
* Quality of technical analysis and documentation.
* Timely completion of assigned technical projects.
* Reduction in delays through proactive coordination.
* Quality and usefulness of information provided to the MD for decision\-making.

**Authority \& Role Positioning**

The Technical Assistant will **not replace functional/project heads** but will support the MD by ensuring that important technical and project information reaches the MD accurately and that decisions/action points are followed through.

The position requires a combination of **Mechanical Engineering knowledge \+ project understanding \+ management reporting \+ strong coordination and follow\-up skills**.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

**Education:** B.E./B.Tech – Mechanical Engineering  
**Experience:** 2–5 years in Water Treatment, Wastewater Treatment, EPC, Mechanical Projects, or related engineering industry.

Candidates with experience in **WTP/STP/ETP/RO projects, mechanical equipment, EPC execution, project coordination, or management reporting** will be preferred.

**Reporting:** Directly to Managing Director

**Salary:** As per candidate's experience and company policy.

**Location:** New Delhi

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

 You’ll partner with Enabling Area / AI Team to unlock value from data and AI through modern analytics and GenAI capabilities (e.g., RAG, LLM integrations) and strong delivery practices.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




 • Lead stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process walkthroughs to elicit and document functional/non\-functional requirements (BRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria).
 



 • Perform gap analysis, feasibility assessments, and traceability from business goals to product features.
 



 • Shape product vision and roadmap for AI features; prioritize backlogs based on value, feasibility, and risk.
 



 • Run Agile ceremonies (refinement, sprint planning, reviews) and maintain clear release plans and OKRs.
 



 • Translate use cases into LLM/GenAI solutions (e.g., retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt engineering, evaluation criteria) with DS/ML engineers.
 



 • Coordinate data availability, model monitoring, and governance (security, privacy, cost/performance) with platform teams.
 



 • Demo increments, validate requirements, and manage UAT with business users; drive adoption and training assets (playbooks, guides).
 



 • Communicate status, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership; support post\-launch analysis and continuous improvement.
 



 • Maintain clear artefacts (journey maps, process flows, personas, wireframes) and QA/test plans in partnership with QA leads.
 



  





**Qualifications**




 • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or Business; MBA is a plus.
 



 • Experience: Typically, 3–5 years in Product/BA roles.
 



 • Core: Proven requirements management, backlog ownership, and Agile delivery with enterprise stakeholders.
 



  





**Skills (Must\-have)**




 • Strong BA toolkit (elicitation, analysis, documentation, UAT).
 



 • Product tools (Jira/ADO/Confluence), and proficiency in MS Office for analysis and communication.
 



 • AI literacy: familiarity with LLMs/GenAI concepts, RAG patterns, evaluation/guardrails, and data governance.
 



 • Collaboration across Data Science, Engineering, UX; excellent stakeholder communication.
 



  





**Preferred Exposure**




 • Hands\-on with prompt design, GenAI evaluation, vector databases, or model lifecycle (training, deployment, monitoring).
 



 • Experience in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and modern data/ML tooling.

 • Requirement lead time (from intake to signed\-off user stories), backlog health, and sprint goal attainment.
 



 • Feature adoption (usage, satisfaction), model performance \& cost (for AI features), and defect escape rate/UAT pass\-rate.
 



  





**Working Model**




 Hybrid, with flexibility for stakeholder workshops, demos, and UAT at office/client sites as needed.
 



  





**How you’ll grow** 




  





***Connect for impact***




  





 Our exceptional team of professionals across the globe are solving some of the world’s most complex business problems, as well as directly supporting our communities, the planet, and each other. Know more in our Global Impact Report and our India Impact Report.

 You can be a leader irrespective of your career level. Our colleagues are characterised by their ability to inspire, support, and provide opportunities for people to deliver their best and grow both as professionals and human beings. Know more about Deloitte and our One Young World partnership.

Know more about everyday steps that you can take to be more inclusive. At Deloitte, we believe in the unique skills, attitude and potential each and every one of us brings to the table to make an impact that matters.
 



  





***Drive your career***




  





 At Deloitte, you are encouraged to take ownership of your career. We recognise there is no one size fits all career path, and global, cross\-business mobility and up / re\-skilling are all within the range of possibilities to shape a unique and fulfilling career. Know more about Life at Deloitte.

description:

**Work From Home \| Internship \| LearnElectronics India**

About the Internship

LearnElectronics India is looking for a **UI/UX \& Wix Website Design Intern** who can help us improve and redesign our website into a modern, professional, user\-friendly platform.

This is a **hands\-on role**. You will not only create UI/UX designs but will also be responsible for **implementing those designs directly on our Wix website using the Wix Site Editor** and preparing the pages for publishing.

You may use **AI tools** such as ChatGPT, image\-generation tools, Figma AI, Canva AI, or other suitable tools to speed up your design and development workflow.

What You Will Work On

* Design modern, clean and professional website pages for LearnElectronics India.
* Improve the **UI/UX, layout, navigation and overall visual experience** of the website.
* Create page layouts, sections, banners, cards, buttons, icons and other visual elements.
* Design pages with **desktop and mobile responsiveness** in mind.
* Implement your designs directly using the **Wix Site Editor**.
* Redesign existing pages and create new pages when required.
* Improve website consistency through typography, spacing, colors, buttons and reusable design patterns.
* Optimize the user journey and make important information easy to find.
* Create attractive layouts for products, courses, training programs, services and other website sections.
* Use AI tools where appropriate for generating design ideas, content, graphics, images or UI concepts.
* Test implemented pages on different screen sizes and fix layout/responsiveness issues.
* Make pages polished and **ready to publish**.

What We Are Looking For

* Basic to good understanding of **UI/UX design principles**.
* Experience or willingness to work with **Wix Website Builder / Wix Site Editor**.
* Good understanding of layouts, typography, colors, spacing and visual hierarchy.
* Ability to create clean, modern and professional website designs.
* Basic understanding of responsive web design.
* Ability to convert a design concept into an actual working webpage.
* Comfortable experimenting with **AI tools for design and productivity**.
* Attention to detail and willingness to iterate based on feedback.
* Creativity and an eye for modern web design.

Tools You May Work With

* **Wix Site Editor**
* Figma
* Canva
* ChatGPT and other AI tools
* AI image\-generation/design tools
* Other tools that help improve the design workflow

You do **not** need to know every tool listed above. What matters most is your ability to create good designs and implement them effectively.

What You Will Learn

* Real\-world UI/UX design for a business website
* Designing and implementing websites using Wix
* Responsive web design
* Website structure and user experience
* Design systems and visual consistency
* Using AI tools in a professional design workflow
* Working on a live business website
* Taking a design from **concept → implementation → testing → publish\-ready website**

Internship Details

**Position:** UI/UX \& Wix Website Design Intern  
**Work Mode:** Work From Home  
**Duration:** 1–2 Months  
**Stipend:** ₹1,000/month  
**Type:** Internship  
**Location:** Remote

Who Can Apply?

Students, freshers and aspiring UI/UX designers who want **practical experience working on a real business website** are welcome to apply.

Prior professional experience is not mandatory. However, you should be able to demonstrate your design skills through **projects, portfolio work, college projects, personal websites or previous UI/UX work**.

Important

This is not a role where you will only provide design files.

You will be expected to **take your designs and implement them on the Wix website yourself**, make the required adjustments, test the pages and bring them to a **publish\-ready stage**.

If you enjoy both **designing and building what you design**, this internship is a good opportunity to gain hands\-on experience.

* Flexible schedule

 We're looking for an experienced
 **People Operations Manager** 
 to join our People team based in Bangalore. In this role, you'll own the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle for our India team while driving operational excellence across HR operations, recruitment, performance management, employee experience, and cross\-functional people initiatives.
   

  

 Reporting to the
 **Head of People** 
 , you'll partner closely with managers across Engineering, Product, Finance, IT, and our global People team to deliver scalable People programs and support a growing business. This role offers a high level of ownership and autonomy, making it ideal for someone who enjoys building efficient processes, working in a fast\-paced environment, and collaborating with stakeholders across multiple functions and time zones.

description:
**Job Description**
**Department:** 
 Human Resources
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are looking for a meticulous, experienced
 **HR Manager** 
 to lead our Talent acquisition \& workforce planning, payroll processing and statutory compliance operations. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on expertise in
 **Saral Payroll software** 
 , comprehensive attendance management, and deep knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory filings (PF, ESI, PT), half\-yearly/annual returns, and the renewal of major establishment licenses (Factory License, Shop \& Establishment).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
* Partner with department heads to forecast manpower requirements for production, quality control, maintenance, supply chain, and administrative teams.
* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment for both contract/temporary labor and permanent shop\-floor and managerial staff.
* Implement effective onboarding programs to ensure rapid integration and a strong safety\-first mindset from day one.
* Payroll \& Attendance Management
* End\-to\-End Processing: Manage monthly payroll processing for employees using Saral Payroll software accurately and within defined timelines.
* Attendance \& Leave Integration: Oversee time\-office management, consolidate attendance, shift rosters, and leave logs, and reconcile discrepancies prior to payroll processing.
* Inputs \& Deductions: Handle inputs related to variable pay, incentives, loans, advances, overtime (OT), and stop\-pay requests.
* Outputs \& Reporting: Generate salary sheets, bank transfer statements, pay slips, and MIS reports for management review.
* Statutory Compliances \& Filings (PF, ESI, PT)
* Monthly Calculations \& Remittances: Ensure timely calculation, generation of challans, and deposition of Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and Professional Tax (PT) within statutory due dates.
* Periodic Returns: Prepare and file Half\-Yearly and Annual Returns under applicable labor legislations seamlessly.
* Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for government authorities, inspectors, and external statutory auditors during audits or inspections.
* Licenses, Registrations \& Renewals
* Factory License: Manage timely Factory License renewals, amendments, and compliance with the Factories Act provisions (safety records, worker registers, etc.), if applicable.
* Shop \& Establishment Act: Handle Shop and Establishment License renewals, timely registration updates, and display management.
* Other Registrations: Track and execute renewals for other regional/central labour licenses (e.g., Contract Labour, LWF if applicable).
* Full \& Final (F\&F) Settlements \& Employee Lifecycle Support
* Exit Processing: Process full and final settlements for resigned/terminated employees, including gratuity, leave encashment, and notice\-pay calculations.
* Query Resolution: Resolve employee queries regarding salary structures, tax deductions, PF transfers/withdrawals, and ESIC benefits efficiently.
* Plant Safety, Health \& Employee Engagement
* Collaborate with the EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety) team to foster a safety\-first culture and ensure compliance with mandatory safety training.
* Design and execute employee engagement initiatives tailored to shift workers and shop\-floor personnel (e.g., reward and recognition programs, health camps, skill competitions).
* Monitor employee turnover, absenteeism, and morale, implementing data\-driven retention strategies.
* Performance Management \& Training
* Administer performance appraisal cycles for plant staff, linking goals to plant Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as productivity, quality, and safety.
* Identify skill gaps and coordinate technical, safety, and soft\-skills training programs in alignment with Lean, Six Sigma, or TPM (Total Productive Maintenance) initiatives.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* Education: Graduate/Post\-Graduate in Human Resources, or a related field.
* Experience: Minimum 8\+ years of core corporate experience specializing in Payroll and Statutory Compliance.
* Software Mastery: Mandatory hands\-on expertise in Saral Payroll software and proficiency in Advanced MS Excel.
* Legal Knowledge: Thorough understanding of the Factories Act, Shops \& Establishment Act, PF \& ESI Act, Professional Tax Act, Payment of Wages Act, and Minimum Wages Act.

 The full S\&M structure: TMT regional sales, VAS, TOPTECH, Technical Services, Digital and CRM
 



**Location** 




 Head office with regional and field HR exposure
 



**Experience** 




 10 to 12 years in HR, from the building materials industry
 



  





**1\. Why this role exists** 




 SRMB is building a large Sales and Marketing organization fast: regional VPs and zonal heads for TMT, a VAS business with its own leadership, a penetration brand, national technical services, and digital and CRM engines. A structure this size, stood up at this pace, lives or dies on talent. The right people have to be found, hired and made productive quickly, and then kept. That is a full\-time job, and it needs a dedicated partner who knows the building materials talent market.
 



 The HRBP for Sales and Marketing is that partner. This role owns talent acquisition and ramp\-up for the S\&M organization, partners the leadership on manpower planning, onboarding, performance and retention, and turns the org charts into filled, performing teams. It reports on a solid line to the Talent Acquisition Leader in HR and on a dotted line to the President and CSMO, so it serves the business closely while staying anchored in the HR function.
 



  





**2\. What this role owns** 



* **Talent acquisition and ramp\-up.** 
 Hire across the S\&M structure and, above all, ramp new talent to productivity fast, from leadership roles to the field.
* **Manpower planning.** 
 Partner S\&M leaders on the manpower plan, role design and prioritization, so hiring tracks the growth plan.
* **Onboarding and time to productivity.** 
 Own structured onboarding and the 30\-60\-90 day journey so new hires deliver sooner.
* **Performance and capability.** 
 Support KRA setting, reviews and capability building across the S\&M teams.
* **Engagement and retention.** 
 Track engagement, manage early attrition, and keep the talent the business has invested in.



  





**3\. Key responsibilities** 



* **Turn the org charts into teams.** 
 Drive hiring against the S\&M manpower plan, close roles to time and quality, and keep the pipeline warm.
* **Ramp talent fast.** 
 Run onboarding, buddy and early\-support programmes that cut time to productivity, and track it as a number.
* **Partner the S\&M leaders.** 
 Work with the VPs and heads on structure, role clarity, KRAs and people decisions, as a trusted business partner.
* **Own the HR cycle for S\&M.** 
 Run performance, confirmation, engagement and retention actions across the S\&M organization.
* **Manage early attrition.** 
 Spot flight risk and early exits, find the causes, and fix them before they cost the business.
* **Bridge business and HR.** 
 Represent S\&M needs to the HR function and HR standards to the business, cleanly, on both reporting lines.



  





**4\. Measurable indices** 




  





**What it measures** 




  





**Fill rate** 




**What it measures** 
 Positions filled against the S\&M manpower plan
 



**Target 90%\+ on plan** 




  





**Time to fill** 




**What it measures** 
 Days to close a role
 



**Target Within agreed benchmark** 




  





**Ramp\-up speed** 




**What it measures** 
 Time from joining to productivity
 



**Target Compressing quarter on quarter** 




  





**Offer to join** 




**What it measures** 
 Offers accepted and actually joined
 



**Target 90%\+ join ratio** 




  





**Early attrition** 




**What it measures** 
 Exits within the first 6 to 12 months
 



**Target Below the agreed threshold** 




  





**Quality of hire** 




**What it measures** 
 New\-hire confirmation and performance
 



**Target High and rising** 




  





**Onboarding** 




**What it measures** 
 30\-60\-90 day onboarding completion
 



**Target 100%** 




  





**Engagement and retention** 




**What it measures** 
 S\&M engagement score and regretted attrition
 



**Target Improving year on year** 




  





**5\. Who we are looking for** 



* 10 to 12 years in HR, as an HRBP or in talent acquisition, from the building materials industry: steel, cement, paints, tiles, pipes or construction chemicals.
* At Manager level and not below, with the maturity to partner senior S\&M leaders as an equal.
* A proven record of ramping up talent, having built or scaled teams at pace in a prior role.
* Real knowledge of the building materials sales and marketing talent market, and where the right people sit.
* Strong on hiring, onboarding, performance partnering and retention, and comfortable working two reporting lines.
* MBA in HR preferred, with data fluency and a field\-ready, hands\-on style.



  





**6\. What good looks like in year one** 




 The S\&M org charts are becoming filled, performing teams. Roles are closing to time and quality, new hires are productive faster because onboarding and early support actually work, and early attrition is under control. The S\&M leaders treat the HRBP as a genuine partner, HR standards hold on both reporting lines, and talent has stopped being the thing that slows the growth plan down.

title: Group Supply Chain Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
**Group Supply Chain Analyst**
**Mumbai, India**
**Permanent position**
**The Role**
 The Supply Chain Analyst is the process owner and subject matter expert for the James Fisher and Sons Approved Vendor List (AVL) platform, supplier onboarding process and Group Supply Chain data systems.
   

  

 The role exists to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of supplier data across the group, to drive continuous improvement of the AVL system and associated processes, and to provide data\-driven insight through business intelligence reporting that supports group\-wide procurement decision\-making.
   

  

**Key Duties And Responsibilities**
**Supply Chain data integrity** 
 :
   

  

 Own and maintain the completeness and accuracy of the JFS Approved Vendor List, ensuring all supplier records meet defined data quality standards and that processes are in place to sustain that quality over time.
   

  

**Supplier onboarding** 
 : Serve as the subject matter expert for the supplier onboarding process, managing the end\-to\-end workflow from initial registration through qualification, compliance checks, and activation on the AVL platform.
   

  

**System improvement** 
 : Work with Synergi (the AVL platform provider) and internal IT stakeholders to identify, specify, and drive continuous improvement of the Dynamics 365 and Power Pages AVL platform, acting as the primary interface between supply chain and technology on system matters.
   

  

**Business intelligence** 
 : Design, build, improve and maintain procurement BI dashboards and reporting across the group, ensuring stakeholders have timely and accurate visibility of supplier data, spend analytics, and compliance status.
   

  

**Process development** 
 : Develop, document, and embed the processes, controls, and working practices that govern how supply chain data is created, maintained, and validated across the group, including duplicate detection, re\-evaluation workflows, and data governance standards.
   

  

**Compliance support** 
 : Support the group's compliance obligations by ensuring the AVL operates as an effective control vehicle for sanctions screening, financial health monitoring, and Code of Conduct compliance, aligned to the requirements of the group entity level controls framework.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
 A key challenge for this role is operating as a sole contributor in a newly established group function, requiring the ability to build credibility and working relationships across multiple divisions and geographies without direct authority.
   

  

 This role is a dedicated resource for Group Supply Chain systems and data across the James Fisher group. The postholder must be capable of operating with a high degree of autonomy and self\-direction.
   

  

 The AVL platform (Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Pages) was built by an external systems integrator (Synergi). The postholder will manage the ongoing working relationship with Synergi on technical and process matters and must be comfortable engaging with third\-party technology partners.
   

  

 The Group BI platform is in an early stage of development, having been initiated by an external contractor.
   

  

 There is significant work to do to get full visibility of spend data and operational procurement metrics.
   

  

 The post holder will work with the external contractor to understand the data lake structure and begin to take ownership for the maintenance and improvement of the platform.
   

  

 Responsible for the integrity of the data contained in the AVL database of supplier records, developing and maintaining supply operational dashboards based on ERP purchase order data, inventory data, logistics data and datalake.
   

  

**Key Skills, Knowledge And Experience**
* A Graduate in a relevant discipline such as computer science, information systems, data science, supply chain management, or a related field from a recognised university.
* The postholder will have strong analytical capability and demonstrable proficiency across the Microsoft data and analytics stack, including Dynamics 365, Power Pages, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Power Automate, and Excel.
* Practical experience working with AI tools to enhance data analysis and process efficiency is expected.
* An understanding of supply chain processes and procurement principles is advantageous, though deep technical supply chain expertise is not a prerequisite for the role.
* Strong written and spoken English is essential, given the global nature of the role and the requirement to communicate effectively with stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones.
* Candidates who are early in their career and can demonstrate the required technical aptitude are equally considered alongside those with experience in a data, systems, or supply chain environment.
* The role requires occasional international travel, including to the United Kingdom offices, to engage with divisional supply chain teams and key stakeholders.


 Why join us?
   

  

 Competitive benefits tailored to the division.
   

  

 Opportunities for career growth and visibility across the organisation.
   

  

 A supportive, inclusive culture that values your ideas and contributions.
   

  

 Work that truly makes a difference in safety, innovation, and global capability.
   

  

**About Us**
 James Fisher is a global engineering services company with over 50 years of experience delivering complex offshore energy projects in some of the world’s most challenging environments. title: Data Engineer
description:
**About Bureau** 




  





 Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision\-making engine, powered by a 1 billion\+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.
 



  





 Bureau has raised $50M\+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.
 



  





**Why Bureau?** 




  





 Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.
 



  





 We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  




* Build and maintain batch and streaming pipelines that ingest, clean, and transform data from device SDKs, internal services, partner APIs, and third\-party data providers
* Write and own backend services and RESTful APIs that serve data to internal teams and to real\-time decisioning paths
* Develop Airflow DAGs powering reporting, compliance analytics, model training, and feature pipelines, and keep them healthy day to day
* Write Spark jobs and SQL transformations against our data lake, and tune them when they get slow or expensive
* Add monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks to the pipelines you own so problems surface before a stakeholder notices
* Debug production issues across the stack: a Kafka consumer lagging, a schema change breaking downstream, a query that got 10x slower after a data volume jump
* Work with the infrastructure your pipelines and services run on — containers, deployments, cluster configs — and help keep it stable and cost\-sane
* Contribute to our identity graph work, helping model relationships between entities to surface fraud rings and hidden linkages
* Write documentation and tests, participate in design reviews, and help keep our schemas and contracts sane as the system grows



  





**What You'll Bring** 




  





**Must have** 




  




* 1–3 years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful exposure to data\-intensive systems
* Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or Scala, and the ability to write production\-quality, tested code
* Strong SQL: joins, window functions, aggregations, and enough of a mental model of query execution to know why something is slow
* Working understanding of databases, including the difference between OLTP and OLAP systems and when each is appropriate
* Hands\-on experience with at least one distributed data processing framework (Spark preferred) or a genuine willingness to ramp up quickly
* Experience building or maintaining backend services and REST APIs
* Familiarity with a major cloud platform (AWS preferred) and core services like S3, EC2, and managed databases
* Solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, concurrency, and the basics of distributed systems
* Comfort with Git, code review, and CI/CD



  





**Nice to have** 




  




* Infrastructure and systems knowledge — Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform or similar IaC, and a working sense of how services get deployed, scaled, and monitored in production
* Experience running or tuning distributed workloads: cluster sizing, resource tuning, or tracking down a bottleneck between compute and storage
* Exposure to Kafka or MSK, or any streaming/event\-driven system
* Experience with Airflow or a similar orchestration tool
* Exposure to EMR, Athena, ClickHouse, Databricks, or Snowflake
* Awareness of lakehouse table formats such as Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi
* Familiarity with observability tooling — Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent
* Any experience with graph databases (Neo4j, TigerGraph, Amazon Neptune)
* Interest in or exposure to fraud, risk, identity, fintech, or other high\-stakes real\-time domains
* Exposure to ML workflows: feature pipelines, training data preparation, or model serving



  





**What We Look For** 




  




* You debug rather than guess, and you can explain what actually went wrong
* You ask what the data is for before deciding how to model it
* You're curious about the layer below the one you work in — how your code actually runs, where it fails, what it costs
* You're comfortable being new to a tool and getting productive in it quickly
* You care that numbers are right, because at Bureau a wrong number is a wrong risk decision



  





**Our Culture** 




  




* We hire self\-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most



  





**Compensation** 




  




* Competitive salary \+ potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

 Driving lasting impact and building long\-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture \- doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:
   

  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World\-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 Your specific project activities include performing diagnostics and customizing and implementing our analytical tools across the clients’ organization.
   

  

 You’ll work in teams playing an active role in the client engagement. You will use a tech\-enabled approach to tackle client challenges related to end\-to\-end supply chain planning from demand forecasting and inventory management to S\&OP, production planning and scheduling, and order management.
   

  

 The increasing complexity of integrated tactical and operational systems, combined with an explosion of data, makes these topics both top\-of\-mind and deeply challenging for many clients. Capitalizing upon your analytics and data science background, you will fortify and enhance Manufacturing and Supply Chain's (MSC’s) digital tools to customize the output to precise client situations. Most importantly, you will develop insights and implement solutions which produce tangible and lasting impact on our clients’ operational performance.
   

  

 Your client’s projects will range from quick diagnostics up to multi\-month digital implementations. In between studies, you will bring your learnings back to our internal team to help refine digital modules and ideate powerful new capabilities.
   

  

 Through your work, you’ll have opportunities to present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members. You’ll gain new skills and build on the strengths you bring to the firm.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
* Master’s degree in an analytics/data centric area such as supply chain management, mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science, or industrial engineering
* 1\+ years of operations research, analytics and/or data science work in industry with a focus on supply chain topics (internships may count as work experience)
* Outstanding record of academic achievement
* Knowledge of analytical concepts relevant for supply chain optimization, such as statistics, time\-series analyses, and classical operations research methods, in particular mathematical programming (esp. mixed\-integer linear programming) and corresponding IT tools (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, AIMMs), and methods from applied statistics (esp. time series forecasting) and stochastic modelling and optimization (e.g., Markov Decision Processes)
* Understanding of IT (e.g. databases and data structures) and demonstrated knowledge of at least one standard programming language (e.g. Python, C\+\+, Java)
* Good understanding of supply chain concepts such as supply chain strategy, production management, scheduling, network design, inventory, and logistics
* Demonstrated strong conceptual and analytical skills; success in working on high impact cross\-functional teams; strong decision making and problem\-solving skills
* Demonstrated aptitude for analytics and data science, plus appropriate educational and on\-the\-job training
* Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities, and an entrepreneurial bent
* Ability to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 60%, occasionally internationally
* Language fluency skills to communicate complex ideas effectively – both verbally and in writing – in English

title: Robotics Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities
 * Develop and test software modules for medical robotic systems, including sensing, perception, kinematics, motion planning, control, and human\-machine interaction.
* Implement forward and inverse kinematics, coordinate transformations, calibration methods, and trajectory\-generation algorithms for robotic manipulators or medical devices.
* Integrate cameras, depth sensors, force/torque sensors, encoders, tracking systems, and other sensing components used in image\-guided or robot\-assisted workflows.
* Develop computer vision and 3D perception modules for instrument detection, patient or anatomy localization, pose estimation, point\-cloud processing, and scene understanding.
* Use robotics middleware and simulation environments to prototype and validate algorithms before deployment on physical hardware.
* Support integration of medical imaging data, such as DICOM\-derived anatomy, segmentation masks, surface models, or planned trajectories, into robotic guidance workflows.
* Conduct module\-level and system\-level testing, document test results, analyze failures, and support verification of robotic functions under defined operating scenarios.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to build rapid prototypes and proof\-of\-concept solutions for surgical robotics, interventional systems, rehabilitation robotics, or clinical automation.
* Maintain clear technical documentation covering software design, interfaces, assumptions, calibration procedures, experiments, and results.


 Required Qualifications
 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field.
* Less than 3 years of professional, research, internship, or project experience in robotics, automation, control systems, computer vision, or medical\-device development.
* Strong understanding of rigid\-body transformations, coordinate frames, forward and inverse kinematics, basic dynamics, motion planning, and feedback control.
* Hands\-on programming experience in C\+\+ and/or Python, with good software engineering and debugging practices.
* Experience with ROS or ROS 2 and familiarity with robotics concepts such as nodes, topics, services, transforms, robot descriptions, and sensor integration.
* Exposure to simulation tools such as Gazebo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, CoppeliaSim, Webots, MATLAB/Simulink, or similar environments.
* Familiarity with computer vision or 3D processing libraries such as OpenCV, PCL, Open3D, Eigen, or similar frameworks.
* Ability to work with sensors, embedded or robotic hardware, communication interfaces, and basic laboratory test equipment.
* Good problem\-solving skills, attention to safety and detail, and ability to document experiments, interfaces, and test outcomes clearly.
* Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with robotics, imaging, software, systems, quality, and clinical\-domain teams.


 Preferred Skills
 * Exposure to image\-guided surgery, surgical robotics, interventional robotics, rehabilitation robotics, navigation systems, or medical\-device automation.
* Familiarity with registration, tracking, hand\-eye calibration, robot\-to\-image coordinate mapping, or patient\-specific path planning.
* Understanding of force control, impedance or admittance control, collision detection, safety limits, and fail\-safe behavior.
* Experience with RGB\-D cameras, optical or electromagnetic tracking, point clouds, SLAM, pose estimation, or deep\-learning\-based perception.
* Basic knowledge of medical imaging formats and tools such as DICOM, 3D Slicer, SimpleITK, VTK, or similar frameworks.


 Good to have
 * Exposure to hardware\-in\-the\-loop, model\-in\-the\-loop, software\-in\-the\-loop, or processor\-in\-the\-loop validation approaches.
* Experience developing lightweight user interfaces, visualization tools, or operator consoles using Qt, Unity, web frameworks, or similar tools.
* Awareness of medical\-device software lifecycle, risk management, usability engineering, cybersecurity, and regulatory expectations such as IEC 62304, ISO 14971, or IEC 60601 concepts.

title: Associate Field Reporting
description:
**Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients**
 At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission \- to serve patients living with serious illnesses \- drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas \- Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease \- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science\-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Let's do this. Let's change the world. In this vital role, the Associate, Field Reporting will provide hands\-on technical and operational support for field and leadership reporting. The role will help develop, enhance, validate, refresh, and release dashboards that enable field representatives and leaders to understand targets, execution, customer engagement, sales performance, and business trends.
   

  

 This position reports to a Senior Manager within Field Excellence and works across business reporting, technical reporting, iDNA/data\-management, Incentive Compensation, Field Effectiveness, analytics, and field teams. The role supports reporting platforms such as Vision and Gateway and follows an agile, Jira\-based delivery model.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Dashboard Development and Enhancements
   

  

* Build and enhance Tableau dashboards and report tabs using approved requirements, mockups, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
* Configure KPIs, calculations, filters, hierarchies, navigation, customer and geography views, and other user\-facing report features.
* Support minor and major enhancements, including new metrics, source changes, field\-force changes, visual redesigns, and new\-report development.


 Reporting Operations and Release Management
   

  

* Execute scheduled test refreshes, production refreshes, quality checks, approvals, and releases for assigned Vision and Gateway reports.
* Monitor refreshes and report availability, investigate failures or anomalies, implement approved fixes, and communicate status within agreed service levels.
* Support quarterly switchovers, report archival, server or platform maintenance, and other recurring reporting\-operations activities.


 Data Validation and Quality Control
   

  

* Validate dashboard outputs against approved business rules, source data, analytical benchmarks, and acceptance criteria.
* Perform unit, functional, regression, and data\-quality checks across calculations, filters, access controls, layouts, and user personas.
* Document validation evidence, defects, root\-cause findings, fixes, and release sign\-offs to support quality, governance, and audit readiness.


 Requirements and Field Support
   

  

* Support assessment of reporting requests by clarifying the business objective, users, KPIs, data needs, dependencies, priority, and acceptance criteria.
* Contribute to report mockups, technical designs, data\-requirement documentation, effort estimates, and implementation plans under the guidance of reporting leads.
* Respond to routine field and stakeholder questions, investigate data or dashboard inquiries, and provide clear resolutions or escalations.


 Sprint Delivery and Issue Management
   

  

* Maintain accurate Jira tickets, including requirements, acceptance criteria, development details, estimates, dependencies, testing evidence, and status.
* Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily coordination, demonstrations, and retrospectives for assigned work.
* Identify delivery risks early, coordinate across business and technical partners, and drive assigned issues and action items through timely closure.


 Access, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Process assigned user\-access and exception requests and validate that report access is limited to approved business scope and user personas.
* Follow approved development, release, access\-control, documentation, and data\-handling processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve dashboard performance, simplify recurring operations, strengthen controls, and automate repeatable validation or refresh activities.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Partner with Field Effectiveness, Incentive Compensation, analytics, iDNA/data\-management, cross\-system operations, and field stakeholders to deliver end\-to\-end reporting changes.
* Coordinate data dependencies, UAT readiness, feedback, and production\-release activities with business and technical partners.
* Communicate progress, decisions, risks, and support needs clearly to stakeholders across geographies and levels.


 What we expect of you
   

  

 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's degree or Bachelor's degree and 1 \- 3 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, dashboard development, commercial reporting, and/or sales operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in the bio/pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
* Hands\-on experience developing and supporting Tableau dashboards; exposure to enterprise reporting portals is preferred.
* Ability to write SQL queries, assess data requirements, reconcile outputs, and investigate data issues; familiarity with Databricks or comparable data platforms is helpful.
* Strong understanding of data visualization, dashboard usability, calculations, filters, geographic hierarchies, and role\-based access.
* Experience with commercial data such as sales, activity, targets, goals, customer/account, claims, and engagement data.
* Experience working in agile delivery models and using Jira or similar tools for backlog, sprint, issue, and release management.
* Strong quality\-control discipline, attention to detail, and ability to document testing evidence and communicate defects clearly.
* Effective written and verbal communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.


 What you can expect of us
   

  

 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we'll support your journey every step of the way.
   

  

 In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity and Accommodation
   

  

 As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed, and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**👩 💻 The role** 




 We're looking for a sharp, hungry analyst to join the data team at Headout. This is a foundational role, you'll work closely with senior analysts and leadership to build the reports, dashboards, and automations that power decisions across the company.
 



  





 Depending on where the need is greatest and where your strengths lie, you could find yourself working on growth and marketing analytics, product analytics, operations and supply\-side problems, or a mix of all three. The common thread: you'll be embedded in the business, working on problems that matter.
 



  





 This isn't about crunching numbers in a corner. You'll understand how our marketplace works, why metrics move, and what levers actually drive outcomes. You'll ship real work within your first week, and own meaningful workstreams within your first few months.
 



  





 If you're someone who gets restless when you're not learning, who'd rather figure things out than wait for instructions, and who cares about craft, this is for you.
 



  





**🤩 What makes this role special?** 



* **Real problems, not busywork** 
 : Headout is a global marketplace operating across dozens of cities, thousands of experiences, multiple currencies, real\-time inventory, and dynamic pricing. Whether you're analyzing conversion funnels, attribution models, supplier economics, or product experiments, the problems here are genuinely hard.
* **Breadth of exposure** 
 : You won't be siloed into one corner of the business. You'll see how growth, product, operations, and finance interconnect and build the analytical muscle to work across all of them.
* **Learn fast by doing** 
 : You'll pair with senior analysts on complex projects, get direct feedback from leadership, and see your work influence actual decisions. The feedback loops are tight, and the growth curve is steep.
* **A team that gives a damn** 
 : We care about speed and pragmatism over perfection, but we don't ship sloppy work. Feedback is direct and frequent. We document what we learn. We help each other get better.
* **A product you can care about** 
 : Headout helps people experience the best of every city they visit. There's something satisfying about working on a product where the output is someone having a great day somewhere new.



  





**💝 What skills \& experience do you need?** 



* 1 \- 3 years in an analytics, BI, or data science role
* Strong SQL skills, you can write complex joins, window functions, CTEs without hand\-holding. You know how to debug a slow query.
* Working knowledge of Python for data manipulation, automation, or simple analysis
* Hands\-on experience with at least one BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
* Nice to have: exposure to dbt, Airflow, or similar; basic understanding of data warehousing concepts
* Bonus: exposure to marketplace/e\-commerce, consumer tech

title: Software Quality Engineer
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a passionate
 **Quality Engineer** 
 with strong software development, automation, and AI skills. You will build frameworks, tools, and intelligent solutions that improve product testability, accelerate defect detection, and enable quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for desktop, web, API, and system\-level testing.
* Develop reusable software tools, libraries, APIs, and utilities that improve testability and engineering productivity.
* Partner with developers to review designs, improve code testability, and drive Shift\-Left quality practices.
* Integrate automated validation and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Apply AI and intelligent algorithms to generate tests, analyze logs, identify failure patterns, and accelerate root cause analysis.
* Automate the collection, transformation, and reporting of test results and quality metrics.
* Build actionable dashboards using Power BI or similar reporting tools.
* Support DevOps, continuous testing, and release\-readiness initiatives.


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* Strong software development experience using C\#, Java, Python, TypeScript, or a similar programming language.
* Strong understanding of OOP, OOD, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and clean coding practices.
* Experience developing automation frameworks, developer tools, APIs, libraries, or test infrastructure.
* Experience with UI automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, WinAppDriver, or Coded UI.
* Experience with API testing frameworks such as RestAssured, Postman, SoapUI, JUnit, or TestNG.
* Knowledge of REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, SQL, Git, and web\-service technologies.
* Experience integrating automated tests into Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar CI/CD platforms.
* Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, AI\-assisted coding, prompt engineering, LLM APIs, intelligent test generation, or log and failure analysis using AI.
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.


**Minimum Qualifications**
 Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years
   

  

**About KLA**
 We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
   

  

**Use of AI Statement**
 At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem\-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
   

  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

description:
**Description**
 The IES (International Emerging Stores) Shopping team builds products and services that solve unique customer needs across Amazon's fastest growing emerging marketplaces — Brazil, Mexico, Australia, Singapore, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Turkey, Egypt, South Africa, India, and more. We are a multi\-billion dollar business with huge potential to grow across trillion dollar markets.
   

  

 If you are looking for an opportunity to test technology solutions that positively impact hundreds of millions of international customers, and relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today!
   

  

 As part of this team you will work to ensure our emerging stores are FAST and deliver the best shopping experience — across diverse languages, cultures, and emerging consumer behaviors. It's a great opportunity to test and enhance experiences for Mobile devices first. You will get the opportunity to work on Amazon Mobile Shopping App and almost all key pages on retail website building features and improving business metrics. You will leverage Gen AI to reimagine shopping experiences, personalize for multi\-lingual nuances, and accelerate innovation at scale. You will be part of a team that obsesses about the performance of our customer's experience and enjoy flexibility to pursue what makes sense, working in a fast paced environment, always eager to take on big challenges.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Execute \& Validate
   

  

* Execute test cases. Write and maintain black box test cases with some guidance — including crafting effective prompts and evaluation criteria for Gen AI\-powered features (LLM outputs, recommendations, conversational experiences).
* Drill down on ambiguous task requests (new features/use cases) into clear work instructions through first\-pass execution or training from QA, helping the team start testing without hiccups.
* Reproduce errant product behavior to assist developers or other testers. Identify, track, and accurately report defects with good reproducible reports — steps to repro, logs, clear actual vs. expected results, and helpful title/summary. Verify fixed bugs are truly fixed.


 Technical \& Infrastructure
   

  

* Install and configure software, use debug settings. Gather logs, traces, and relevant artifacts to enrich bug reports when provided detailed instructions.
* Execute and verify results of existing automated tests. Manage and scale lab infrastructure based on project needs.
* Maintain basic understanding of the automation framework to initiate, manage, and maintain automation runs per defined schedule/SLA.


 AI\-Augmented Testing \& Analysis
   

  

* Leverage Gen AI tools to accelerate test case generation, identify edge cases, and improve test coverage — while applying judgment to validate AI\-suggested scenarios against real user behavior across emerging markets.
* Perform defect analysis and help prioritize/escalate issues within your scope. Analyze automation failures by isolating script vs. product failures.
* Give feedback on automation needs, coverage gaps, and quality of test instructions. Act as a catalyst for process sustenance and simplification.


 Initiative \& Simplification
   

  

* Develop simple tools/utilities (including AI\-assisted ones) that improve project metrics — productivity, defect leakage, and quality in owned test areas.
* Identify repetitive workflows and propose simplification through scripting, AI\-assisted triage, or process improvements.
* Help improve stakeholder communication processes — concise reporting, better signal\-to\-noise in status updates.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Knowledge of software test techniques and strategy
* bachelors degree in engineering and experience in testing and knowledge of SDLC and some scripting knowledge in any language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in automation testing

description:

 Full time

 Are you curious, motivated, and forward\-thinking? At FIS, you’ll have the opportunity to support the coordination and delivery of meaningful projects that connect financial services with modern technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate, and above all, fun.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You will be part of our QA and Test Services (QATS) team, supporting quality engineering initiatives for critical client applications. In this role, you will contribute to Manual, Functional, and Automation testing practices across delivery teams, working closely with QA leads, SDETs, engineering, and business stakeholders. You will help execute test strategy, improve product quality, and support reliable releases through well\-planned testing and CI/CD\-aligned automation.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Analyze business and functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to identify test conditions, scenarios, and edge cases.
* Perform Manual and Functional testing across application components, services, and end\-to\-end business flows, including smoke, sanity, regression, integration, and UAT support.
* Prepare, review, and maintain high\-quality test cases, test scenarios, and test data with clear steps, expected results, and coverage mapping.
* Execute test cases (manual and automated), log defects with clear reproduction steps, track them to closure, and share concise test execution and status reports.
* Manage test artifacts in Jira and Zephyr — create and run test cycles, link test cases to stories and defects, and maintain traceability from requirement → test case → execution → defect.
* Participate in requirement walkthroughs, sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, defect triage, and release readiness reviews.

* Contribute to Automation testing by building and maintaining automated tests for Web Applications and Web Services using Playwright, Selenium, and related tools in Java/C\#.
* Support Unit Test practices with clear code coverage and meaningful assertions where applicable.
* Help integrate automated tests into DevOps pipelines and CI tools (for example Jenkins/Bamboo) under guidance of senior team members.
* Identify candidates for automation from the existing manual regression suite and convert them progressively.
* Apply object\-oriented programming principles using Java/C\# when writing or maintaining automation code.
* Follow coding standards, SDLC best practices, and quality engineering guidelines consistently.
* Analyze system behavior and troubleshoot issues across UI, API, and data layers with strong problem\-solving skills.
* Document test strategy inputs, reusable test patterns, and lessons learned for wider team adoption.
* Collaborate with QA and engineering teams to establish test cases, test data, and environment readiness across environments.
* Support quality\-focused infrastructure and operational documentation.
* Assist in building and integrating GenAI, LLM, and Agentic AI solutions to accelerate QA activities such as test case generation, test data creation, and defect analysis.
* Explore emerging technologies such as MCP, multi\-agent systems, and AI\-assisted testing to improve delivery outcomes.
* Identify recurring issues and process gaps, and apply AI\-assisted solutions where appropriate.


**What You Bring**
* 2\+ years of relevant work experience in software quality engineering, covering Manual, Functional, and Automation testing.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Manual and Functional testing — requirement analysis, test case design, test data preparation, execution, and defect lifecycle management.
* Practical working experience with Jira and Zephyr (or equivalent test management tools) for test case preparation, test cycle execution, defect tracking, and requirement traceability.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in API testing (REST, SOAP, RPC) using Postman, Bruno, or similar tools.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on Automation Testing experience with frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, XUnit, or NUnit.
* Working programming skills in Java/C\#/Python with understanding of object\-oriented programming fundamentals.
* Working knowledge of DevOps and Continuous Integration tooling.
* Good knowledge of XML and HTML.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills (verbal and written English).
* Ability to learn new technologies quickly and work effectively across functional teams.
* Basic understanding of architecture design concepts and software development lifecycle processes.
* Exposure to GenAI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, or Agentic AI concepts.
* Practical use of GitHub Copilot for faster and higher\-quality delivery across test cases, test data, and automation.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn, evaluate, and apply emerging AI technologies responsibly.


**Added Bonus if you have**
* Experience in financial services or payment domain.
* Familiarity with ISO 8583 message format.
* Exposure to BDD/TSS frameworks such as Cucumber or SpecFlow.
* Awareness of code coverage/quality tools such as SonarQube.
* Exposure to C\#, Java, Python, Oracle PL/SQL, Postman, or Bruno.
* Hands\-on experience with JavaScript, PowerShell, CSS, or related test automation ecosystem tools.

* An exciting opportunity to be part of the world’s leading FinTech product organization.
* A vibrant team environment and the opportunity to build a career in the core banking/payments domain.
